Namaz mein muqtadi aur imam ka talluq haq ko hum ne is Kalam-e-Pak mein poori tarah wazeh kar diya hai aur misalein de de kar samjha diya hai ke logon par haq khul jaye aur is ki tabadari mein lag jayen. Unke pas to koi bhi mojiza ajaye kaisa hi nishan-e-haq dekh lein lekin yeh jhat se bila-ghor al-foran kahenge ke yeh jadoo hai, batil hai, jhoot hai. Dekhiye chand ko do tukre hote dekhte hain aur iman nahi laate. Khud Quran-e-Kareem ki ayat (Innal-lazina haqqat ‘alayhim kalimatur rabbika la yu'minoon) (Surah Yunus: 96) mein hai ke jin par tere Rab ki baat sabit ho chuki hai woh iman nahi layenge go un ke pas tamam nishaniyan ajayin yahan tak ke woh dardnak azab ka mu'aina kar lein. Pas yahan bhi farmata hai ke be-ilm logon ke dilon par usi tarah Allah ki mohar lag jati hai. A Nabi ﷺ ap sabr kijiye in ki mukhalifat aur dushmani par dar-guzar kiye chale jayiye. Allah ka wada sacha hai woh zaroor tumhein ek din un par ghalib karega aur tumhari imdad farmayega. Aur duniya aur akhirat mein tujhe aur tere tabadaron ko mukhalifin par ghalba dega. Tumhein chahiye ke apne kaam par lage raho haq par jam jao is se ek inch idhar udhar na hato isi mein sari hidayat hai baqi sab batil ke dher hain. Hazrat Qatada farmate hain ke Hazrat Ali ؓ ek martaba subh ki namaz mein the ke ek khariji ne ap ka naam le kar zor se is ayat ki tilawat ki: (Wa laqad ouhiya ilayka wa ilal-lazina min qablika la-in ashrakta layhabatanna ‘amaluka wa latakoonanna minal-khasirin) (Surah Az-Zumar: 65). Ap ne khamoshi se is ayat ko suna samjha aur namaz hi mein is ke jawab mein ayat (Fasbir inna wa-dal-lahi haqquw wa la yastakhif-fannakal-lazina la yuqinoon) (Surah Ar-Rum: 60) tilawat farmai. (Ibn Jarir, Ibn Abi Hatim).

Woh hadith jis se is mubarak surat ki fazilat aur is ki qirat ka subh ki namaz mein mustahab hona sabit hota hai: Ek Sahabi R.A farmate hain Huzoor ﷺ ne ek din subh ki namaz parhate hue isi surat ki qirat ki. Asna-e-qirat mein ap ko wahm ya saho ho gaya, farigh ho kar farmane lage tum mein ba'z aise log bhi hain jo hamare sath namaz mein shamil hote hain lekin ba-qaida theek thak wuzu nahi karte. Tum mein se jo bhi hamare sath namaz mein shamil ho use achhi tarah wuzu karna chahiye (Musnad Ahmad). Is ki isnad hasan hai, matan bhi hasan hai aur is mein ek ajeeb bhed hai aur bahut badi khair hai aur woh yeh ke ap ke muqtadiyon ke wuzu bilkul durust na hone ka asar ap par bhi pada. Pas sabit hua ke muqtadiyon ki namaz imam ki namaz ke sath mualq hai.

Lahoo-o-laib, mausiqi aur lagho baatein. Upar bayaan hua tha nek-bakhton ka jo Kitabullah se hidayat paate the aur usse sun kar nafa uthate the. To yahan bayaan ho raha hai un badbakhton ka jo Kalam-e-Ilahi ko sun kar nafa hasil karne se baaz rehte hain aur bajaye iske gaane-bajane, baaje-gaaje, dhol-tashe sunte hain. Chunacha is ayat ki tafseer mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) farmate hain: Qasam Allah ki isse murad gaana aur raag hai. Ek aur jagah hai ke aap se is ayat ka matlab pucha gaya to aap ne teen dafa qasam kha kar farmaya ke isse maqsad gaana aur raag aur raagniyan hain. Yehi qool Hazrat Ibn Abbas, Jabir, Ikrimah, Saeed bin Jubair, Mujahid, Makhool, Amr bin Shuaib, Ali bin Bazimah ka hai. Imam Hasan Basri farmate hain ke ye ayat gaane-bajane, baajon-gaajon ke baare mein utri hai. Hazrat Qatadah farmate hain ke isse murad sirf wahi nahi jo is lahoo-o-laib mein paise kharche, yahan murad khareed se isse mehboob rakhna aur pasand karna hai. Insaan ko yehi gumraahi kafi hai ke lagho baat khareedne se murad gaane wali londiyon ki kharidari hai. Chunacha Ibn Abi Hatim waghaira mein Rasulullah (ﷺ) ka farmaan hai ke gaane waliyon ki khareedo-farokht halal nahi aur un ki qeemat ka khana haram hai, unhi ke baare mein yehi ayat utri hai. Imam Tirmizi bhi is hadith ko laaye hain aur isse gharib kaha hai aur iske ek rawi Ali bin Zaid ko zaeef kaha hai. Main kehta hoon khud Ali, unke ustaad aur unke tamam shagird zaeef hain. Wallahu A'lam.

Dahhak ka qool hai ke murad isse shirq hai. Imam Ibn Jareer ka faisla yeh hai ke har woh kalam jo Allah se aur itti-ba-e-shariat se roke, woh is ayat ke hukum mein dakhil hai. Isse gharz iski Islam aur Ahl-e-Islam ki mukhalifat hoti hai. Ek qirat mein liyudilla hai to laam laam-e-aaqibat hoga ya laam-e-ta'leel hoga, yaani amr-e-taqdeeri unki is kar-guzari se ho kar rahega. Aise log Allah ki raah ko hansi bana lete hain, ayat-e-Allah ko bhi mazak mein udaate hain. Ab unka anjam bhi sun lo ke jis tarah unhon ne Allah ki raah ki, Kitabullah ki ihant ki, Qiyamat ke din unki ihant hogi aur khatarnak azab mein zaleel-o-ruswa honge.

Phir bayaan ho raha hai ke yeh na-naseeb jo khel-tamashon, baajon-gaajon par, raag-raagniyon par reejha huwa hai, yeh Quran ki ayton se bhagta hai, kaan unse behre kar leta hai, yeh isse achhi nahi maloom hotin. Sun bhi leta hai to be-suni kar deta hai, balkay unka sunna isse nagwaar guzarta hai, koi maza nahi aata, woh ise fuzool kaam qarar deta hai kyunke iski koi ahmiyat aur izzat uske dil mein nahi, isliye woh unse koi nafa hasil nahi kar sakta, woh to unse mahz be-parwah hai. Yeh yahan Allah ki ayton se uktaata hai to Qiyamat ke din azab bhi woh honge ke ukta-ukta uthega. Yahan ayat-e-Quran sun kar isse dukh hota hai, wahan dukh dene wale azab isse bhugatne parenge.

Allah Ta'ala ke waade talte nahi, naik logon ka anjam bayan ho raha hai ke jo Allah par iman laye, Rasool ko mante rahe, shariat ki matahati mein naik kaam karte rahe, un ke liye jannatein hain jin mein tarah tarah ki naimatein, lazeez ghazayein, behtareen poshakein, umda umda sawariyan, pakeeza noorani chehron wali biwiyan hain. Wahan unhein aur un ki nematon ko dawam hai, kabhi zawal nahi. Na to yeh marenge, na un ki nematein fana hon, na kam hon, na kharab hon. Yeh hatman aur yaqinan hone wala hai kyunke Allah farma chuka hai aur Rab ki baatein badalti nahi, us ke waade talte nahi. Woh Kareem hai, Mannan hai, Muhsin hai, Munim hai, jo chahe kar sakta hai. Har cheez par qadir hai, Aziz hai, sab kuch us ke qabze mein hai, Hakeem hai. Koi kaam, koi baat, koi faisla khali az hikmat nahi. Us ne Quran-e-Kareem ko mominon ke liye kafi aur shafi banaya, haan be-e-manon ke kanon mein bojh hain aur ankhon mein andhera hai. Aur ayat mein hai: (Wa nunazzilu minal-qur'ani ma huwa shifa'-un wa rahmat-un lil-mu'minina wa la yaziduz-zalimina illa khasara) (17. Al-Isra: 82) Yani jo Quran hum ne nazil farmaya hai woh mominon ke liye shifa aur rahmat hai aur zalim to nuqsan mein hi barhte hain.

Pahaaron ki meikhein Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala apni qudrat-e-kamila ka bayaan farmata hai ke zameen-o-asman aur saari makhlooq ka khaliq sirf wahi hai. Asman ko us ne besatoon ooncha rakha hai. Waqai mein koi satoon nahi. Go Mujahid R.H ka yeh qaul bhi hai ke satoon humein nazar nahi aate. Is masle ka poora faisla main Surah Ra'ad ki tafseer mein likh chuka hoon is liye yahan dohrane ki koi zaroorat nahi. Zameen ko mazboot karne ke liye aur hilne jhulne se bachane ke liye us ne is mein pahaaron ki meikhein gaad din taaki woh tumhein zalzale aur junbish se bacha le. Is qadar qism qism ke bhant bhant ke jandaar is Khaliq-e-Haqiqi ne paida kiye ke aaj tak un ka koi hasar nahi kar saka. Apna khaliq aur akhliq hona bayaan farma kar ab raziq aur razaq hona bayaan farma raha hai ke asman se baarish utaar kar zameen mein se tarah tarah ki paida waar uga di jo dekhne mein khush manzar khane mein besarrar. Nafaa mein bahut behtar. Sha'bi R.H ka qaul hai ke insan bhi zameen ki paidawar hai, jannati kareem hain aur dozakhi laeem hain. Allah ki yeh saari makhlooq to tumhare samne hai ab jinhein tum us ke siva poojte ho zara batao to un ki makhlooq kahan hai? Jab nahi to woh khaliq nahi aur jab khaliq nahi to mabood nahi phir un ki ibadat nra zulm aur sakht na-insaafi hai. Fi-al-waqai Allah ke sath shirk karne walon se zyada andha, behra, be-aql, be-ilm, be-samajh, bey-waqooof aur kaun hoga?

Hazrat Luqman Nabi thay ya nahi? Is mein salaf ka ikhtilaf hai ke Hazrat Luqman Nabi thay ya na thay? Aksar hazrat farmatay hain ke Aap Nabi na thay parhizgar Waliullah aur Allah ke pyaray buzurg banday thay. Ibn Abbas R.A se marwi hai ke Aap Habshi ghulam thay aur barhai thay. Hazrat Jabir se jab sawal hua to Aap ne فرمایا: Hazrat Luqman pista qad oonchi naak walay motay hont walay Nabi thay. Said bin Musayyib farmatay hain Aap Misr ke rehnay walay Habshi thay. Aap ko hikmat ata huwi thi lekin nubuwwat nahi mili thi. Aap ne aik martibah aik siyah rang ghulam Habshi se farmaya: Apni rangat ki wajah se apnay taiin haqeer na samajh, teen shakhs jo tamam logon se achay thay teenon siyah rang thay—Hazrat Bilal R.A jo Huzoor Risalat Panah ke ghulam thay, Hazrat Mahja jo Janab Farooq-e-Azam ke ghulam thay, aur Hazrat Luqman Hakim jo Habsha ke Nubah thay. 

Hazrat Khalid Rab'i ka qaul hai ke Hazrat Luqman jo Habshi ghulam barhai thay, un se aik roz un ke malik ne kaha: Bakri zhabah karo aur is ke do behtareen aur nafees tukray gosht ke meray paas laao. Woh dil aur zaban le gaye. Kuch dinon baad un ke malik ne kaha ke bakri zhabah karo aur do badtareen gosht ke tukray meray paas laao. Aap aaj bhi yehi do cheezein le gaye. Malik ne poocha ke is ki kya wajah hai ke behtareen mangay to bhi yehi laaye gaye aur badtareen mangay gaye to bhi yehi laaye gaye, yeh kya baat hai? Aap ne farmaya: Jab yeh achay rahay to in se behtareen jism ka koi uzu nahi aur jab yeh buray ban jayen to phir sab se badtar bhi yehi hain. 

Hazrat Mujahid ka qaul hai ke Hazrat Luqman Nabi na thay naik banday thay, siyah faam ghulam thay, motay honton walay aur bharay qadmon walay. Aur buzurg se bhi yeh marwi hai ke Bani Israel mein qazi thay. Aik aur qaul hai ke Aap Hazrat Dawud A.S ke zamanay mein thay. Aik martibah Aap kisi majlis mein waaz farma rahay thay ke aik charwahay ne Aap ko dekh kar kaha: Kya tu wohi nahi hai jo meray sath falan falan jagah bakriyan charaya karta tha? Aap ne farmaya: Haan, main wohi hoon. Us ne kaha: Phir tujhe yeh martaba kaisay hasil hua? Farmaya: Sach bolnay aur bekar kalam na karnay se. 

Aur riwayat mein hai ke Aap ne apni bulandi ki wajah yeh bayan ki ke Allah ka fazl aur amanat adaa-e-giri aur kalam ki sachai aur be-nafa kaam ko chor dena. Al-gharz aisay hi asar saaf hain ke Aap Nabi na thay. Baaz riwayatein aur bhi hain jin mein go sarahat nahi ke Aap Nabi na thay lekin un mein bhi Aap ka ghulam hona bayan kiya gaya hai jo suboot hai is amr ka ke Aap Nabi na thay kyunke ghulami nubuwwat ke manafi hai. Anbiya-e-Kiram aali nasab aur aali khandan ke huwa kartay thay. Isi liye jumhoor-e-salaf ka qaul hai ke Hazrat Luqman Nabi na thay. Haan, Hazrat Ikrimah se marwi hai ke Aap Nabi thay, lekin yeh bhi jab ke sanad sahih sabit ho jaye, lekin is ki sanad mein Jabir bin Yazid Ju'fi hain jo zaeef hain. Wallahu A'lam. 

Kehtay hain ke Hazrat Luqman Hakim se aik shakhs ne kaha: Kya tu Bani Hashas ka ghulam nahi? Aap ne farmaya: Haan hoon. Us ne kaha: Tu bakriyon ka charwaha nahi?

Aap ne farmaya haan hoon. Kaha gaya toh siyah rang nahi? Aap ne farmaya zahir hai main siyah rang hoon tum yeh batao ke tum kya poochta chahte ho? Us ne kaha yehi ke phir woh kya hai? Ke teri majlis par rehti hai? Log tere darwaze par aate hain teri baatein shauq se sunte hain. Aap ne farmaya suno bhai jo baatein main tumhe kehta hoon un par amal karlo toh tum bhi mujh jaise ho jaoge. Aankhein haram cheezon se band karlo. Zaban behooda baaton se rok lo. Maal halal khaya karo. Apni sharmgah ki hifazat karo. Zaban se sach baat bola karo. Wade ko poora kiya karo. Mehman ki izzat karo. Padosi ka khayal rakho. Be-faida kaamon ko chhod do. Inhi aadat ki wajah se maine buzurgi paayi hai. Abu Dawood (R.A) farmate hain Hazrat Luqman Hakeem kisi bade gharane ke amir aur bahut zyada kunbe qabeele wale na the. Haan un mein bahut si bhali aadein thheen. Woh khush-akhlaq khamosh ghor-o-fikr karne wale gehri nazar wale din ko na sone wale the. Logon ke samne thookte na the na pakhana peshab aur ghusl karte the lagho kaamon se door rehte haste na the jo kalam karte the hikmat se khali na hota tha jis din un ki aulaad faut hui yeh bilkul nahi roye. Woh badshahyon amiron ke paas is liye jaate the ke ghor-o-fikr aur ibrat-o-naseehat hasil karein. Isi wajah se unhein buzurgi mili. Umuman Quran-e-Kareem mein in dono cheezon ka bayan ek sath hai. Yahan bhi isi tarah hai. Wahn ke maana mashaqqat, takleef, zaif waghera ke hain. Ek takleef to hamal ki hoti hai jise maan bardasht karti hai. Halat-e-hamal ke dukh dard ki halat sab ko maloom hai, phir do saal tak use doodh pilati rehti hai aur uski parwarish mein lagi rehti hai. Al-Baqarah: 233) yani jo log apni aulad ko poora poora doodh pilana chahe unke liye akhri intehai sabab yeh hai ke do saal kamil tak in bachon ko inki maaein apna doodh pilayein. Maan ki us takleef ko aulaad ke samne is liye zahir kiya jata hai ke aulaad apni maan ki un meharbaniyon ko yaad karke shukr guzari, ita'at aur ehsan kare jaise aur ayat mein farman-e-aalishan hai ayat (Wa qul rabbirhamhuma kama rabbayani sagheera 17-Al-Isra: 24) hum se dua karo aur kaho ke mere sache parwardigar mere maan baap par is tarah rahm-o-karam farma jis tarah mere bachpan mein woh mujh par rahm kiya karte thay. Yahan farmaya taake tu mera aur apne maan baap ka ehsan-mand ho. Sun le aakhir lautna to meri taraf hai agar meri is baat ko maan liya toh phir behtareen jaza doonga.

Sun lo tum sab laut kar ek din mere samne aane wale hain, us din main tumhe tumhare tamam tar aamal ki khabar doonga.

Suno, tum mujhe meri jaan se zyada azeez ho lekin mere deen se zyada azeez nahi."
