Al-Anbiya: 47), yaani Qiyamat ke din adl ke tarazu rakh kar har ek ko badla denge, koi zulm na kiya jayega. Aur aikat mein hai zarre barabar neki aur zarre barabar burai har ek dekh lega, khwa woh neki ya badi kisi makan mein, mahal mein, qila mein, pathar ke sorakh mein, asmanon ke konon mein, zameen ki teh mein ho, kahin bhi ho Allah Ta'ala se makhfi nahi, woh use la kar pesh karega, woh bare bareek ilm wala hai. Chhoti se chhoti cheez bhi us par zahir hai, andheri raat mein cheenti jo chal rahi ho us ke paon ki aahat ka bhi woh ilm rakhta hai. Baaz ne yeh bhi jaiz rakha hai ke inna mein zameer-e-shaan ki aur qissa ki hai aur is bina par unhon ne misqal ki laam ka pesh parhna bhi jaiz rakha hai lekin pehli baat hi zyada achhi hai. Baaz kehte hain ke sakhra se murad woh pathar hai jo satween asman aur zameen ke niche hain, is ki baaz sanadein bhi Bani Israel se hain agar sahih sabit ho jayein, baaz Sahaba se marwi to hai Wallahu A'lam. Bohat mumkin hai ke yeh bhi Bani Israel se manqool ho lekin un ki kitabon ki kisi baat ko hum na sachi maan sakein na jhutla sakein. Ba-zahir yeh maloom hota hai ke ba-qadar rai ke daane ke koi amal haqeer ho aur aisa posheeda ho ke kisi pathar ke andar ho, jaise Musnad Ahmad ki hadith mein hai Rasoolullah ﷺ farmate hain: Agar tum mein se koi shakhs koi amal kare kisi be-sorakh ke pathar ke andar jis ka na koi darwaza ho na khirki ho na sorakh ho, taham Allah Ta'ala use logon par zahir kar dega khwa kuch hi amal ho naik ho ya bad. Phir farmate hain: Bete namaz ka khayal rakhna, is ke faraiz, is ke wajibat, arkaan, auqaat waghera ki poori hifazat karna, apni taqat ke mutabiq poori koshish karna, sath Allah ki baton ki tabligh apnon parayon mein karte rehna, bhali baatein karne aur buri baton se bachne ke liye har ek se kehna aur chunke neki ka hukam yani badi se rokna jo عموماً logon ko karwi lagti hai aur haq-go shakhs se log dushmani rakhte hain is liye sath hi farmaya ke logon se jo eza aur museebat pahuche us par sabr karna, dar-haqeeqat Allah ki raah mein nangi shamshir rehna aur haq par museebatein jhelte hue past himmat na hona yeh bara bhaari aur jawanmardi ka kaam hai. Phir farmate hain: Apna munh logon se na mor, unhein haqeer samajh kar ya apne taiy bara samajh kar logon se takabbur na kar, balke narmi barat, khush-khulqi se pesh aa, khanda-peshani se baat kar.

Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai ke kisi Musalman bhai se tu kushada peshani se hans mukh ho kar mile yeh bhi teri bari neki hai. Tahband aur pajame ko takhne se neecha na kar yeh kibr-o-ghuroor hai aur Allah ko naپسand [na-pasand] hai. Hazrat Luqman ne apne bete ko takbur na karne ki wasiyat ki hai ke aisa na ho ke Allah ke bandon ko haqeer samajh kar tu un se munh mor le aur miskeenon se baat karne se sharmaye. Munh more hue baatein karna bhi ghuroor mein dakhil hai. Bachhein phaar kar lehja badal kar hakimana andaz ke sath ghumanD bhare alfaaz se baat-cheet bhi mamnoo hai. Sa'ar aik beemari hai jo oonton ki gardan mein zahir hoti hai ya sar mein aur is se gardan terhi ho jati hai, pas mutakabbir shakhs ko isi terhe munh wale shakhs se mila diya gaya. Arab umoman takbur ke moqe par sa'ar ka istemal karte hain aur yeh istemal un ke sheron mein bhi mojood hai. Zameen par tan kar akar kar utra kar ghuroor-o-takbur se na chalo yeh chaal Allah ko na-pasand hai. Allah Ta'ala un logon ko na-pasand rakhta hai jo khud-been, mutakabbir, sarkash aur fakhr-o-ghuroor karne wale hon aur ayat mein hai (Wa la tamshi fil ardi marahan, innaka lan takhriqal arda wa lan tablughal jibala toola 37) (17. Al-Isra: 37), yaani akar kar zameen par na chalo na to tum zameen ko phaar sakte ho na paharon ki lambai ko pahunch sakte ho. Is ayat ki tafsir bhi iski jagah guzar chuki hai. Huzoor ﷺ ke samne aik martaba takbur ka zikr kiya gaya to Aap ﷺ ne iski bari mazammat farmai aur farmaya ke aise khud-pasand maghroor logon se Allah ghussa hota hai, is par aik Sahabi ne kaha Ya Rasoolallah ﷺ main jab kapre dhoota hoon aur khoob safed ho jate hain to mujhe bohat achhe lagte hain main un se khush hota hoon. Isi tarah jootey mein tasma bhala lagta hai. Kore ka khoobsurat ghilaf bhala maloom hota hai, Aap ﷺ ne farmaya yeh takbur nahi hai, takbur iska naam hai ke tu haq ko haqeer samjhe aur logon ko zaleel khayal kare. Yeh riwayat aur tareeq se bohat lambi marwi hai aur is mein Hazrat Sabit ke intiqal aur un ki wasiyat ka zikr bhi hai. Aur miyana-rawi ki chaal chal kar na bohat ahista kharaman kharaman na bohat jaldi lambe dak bhar bhar ke. Kalam mein mubaligha na kare, be-faida chekh chilla nahi. Badtareen awaz gadhe ki hai. Jo poori taqat laga kar be-sood chalata hai. Bawajood-ike woh bhi Allah ke samne apni aajizi zahir karta hai. Pas yeh buri misaal de kar samjha diya ke bila-wajah chekhna, dant-dapat karna haram hai. Rasoolallah ﷺ farmate hain buri misalon ke layak hum nahi. Apni de di hui cheez wapas lene wala aisa hai jaise kutta jo qai kar ke chaat leta hai. Nasai mein is ayat ki tafsir mein hai ke Rasoolallah ﷺ ne farmaya jab murgh ki awaz suno to Allah Ta'ala se uska fazal talab karo aur jab gadhe ki awaz suno to Allah Ta'ala se panah talab karo. Is liye ke woh Shaitan ko dekhta hai. Aik riwayat mein hai raat ko. Wallahu A'lam. Yeh wasiyatein Hazrat Luqman Hakim ki nihayat hi nafeh-bakhsh hain. Quran-e-Hakim ne isi liye bayan farmai hain.

Aap se aur bhi bohat hakeemana qaul aur wa'z-o-naseehat ke kalmaat marwi hain. Batour namoonah ke aur dastoor ke hum bhi thore se bayan karte hain. Musnad Ahmad mein ba-zaban-e-Rasoolullah ﷺ Hazrat Luqman Hakeem ka aik qaul yeh bhi marwi hai ke Allah ko jab koi cheez saunp di jaye Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala us ki hifazat karta hai. Aur hadees mein aap ka yeh qaul bhi marwi hai ke tasannu se bach yeh raat ke waqt darauni cheez hai aur din ko mazammat-o-burai wali cheez hai. Aap ne apne bete se yeh bhi farmaya tha ke hikmat se maskeen log baadshah ban jate hain. Aap ka farman hai ke jab kisi majlis mein pahuncho pehle Islami tareeq ke mutabiq salam karo phir majlis ke aik taraf baith jao. Doosre na bole to tum bhi khamosh raho. Agar woh zikrullah karein to tum un mein sab se pehle zyada hissa lene ki koshish karo. Aur agar woh gup shap karein to tum us majlis ko chhod do. Marwi hai ke aap apne bachche ko naseehat karne ke liye jab baithte to rai ki bhari hui aik thaili apne paas rakh lete the aur har har naseehat ke baad aik daana us mein se nikaal lete yahan tak ke thaili khali hogayi to aap ne farmaya bachche agar itni naseehat kisi pahaad ko karta to woh bhi tukde tukde hojata. Chunancha aap ke sahibzade ka bhi yahi haal hua. Rasoolullah ﷺ farmate hain Habshiyon ko rakha karo un mein se teen shakhs ahl-e-jannat ke sardar hain, Luqman Hakeem, Najashi aur Bilal moazzin.
Tawazu aur forutani ka bayan: Hazrat Luqman ne apne bachche ko is ki wasiyat ki thi aur Ibn Abi Dunya ne is masle par aik mustaqil kitab likhi hai. Hum us mein se ahem baatein yahan zikr kar dete hain. Rasoolullah ﷺ farmate hain bohat se paraganda baalon wale, maile kocheele kapdon wale jo kisi bare ghar tak nahi pahunch sakte Allah ke haan itne bare martaba wale hain ke agar woh Allah par koi qasam laga baithein to Allah Ta'ala use bhi poori farma de. Aur hadees mein hai Bara bin Malik aise hi logon mein se hain (R.A). Aik martiba Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne Hazrat Mu'az (R.A) ko qabr-e-Rasool ke paas rote dekh kar daryaft farmaya to jawab mila ke sahib-e-qabr ﷺ se aik hadees main ne suni hai jise yaad karke ro raha hoon. Main ne aap se suna farmate the thori si riyakari bhi shirk hai. Allah Ta'ala unhe dost rakhta hai jo muttaqi hain, jo logon mein chupe chupaye hain, jo kisi ginti mein nahi aate, agar woh kisi majma' mein na hon to koi un ka pursan-e-haal nahi, agar aa jayein to koi aao bhagat nahi lekin un ke dil hidayat ke chiragh hain, woh har aik ghubaar alood andhere se bach kar noor hasil kar lete hain. Huzoor farmate hain yeh maile kocheele kapdon wale jo zaleel gine jate hain Allah ke haan aise muqarrab hain ke agar Allah par qasam kha baithein to Allah poori kar de, go unhe Allah ne duniya nahi di lekin un ki zuban se poori jannat ka sawal bhi nikal jaye to Allah poora kar leta hai.

Aap farmate hain ki meri ummat mein aise log bhi hain ki agar tum mein se kisi ke darwaze par aakar woh log ek dinar ek dirham balki ek fulus bhi mangein toh tum na do lekin Allah ke han woh aise pyare hain ki agar Allah se jannat ki jannat mangein toh Parwardigar de de haan duniya na toh unhein deta hai na rokta hai is liye ki yeh koi qabil-e-qadr cheez nahin. Yeh maile kachhile do chadoron mein rehte hain agar kisi mauqe par qasam kha baithein toh jo qasam unhon ne khai ho Allah puri karta hai. Huzoor farmate hain ki jannat ke badshah log hain jo paraganda aur bikhre hue balon wale hain ghubar alud aur gard se atte hue woh amiron ke ghar jana chahein toh unhein ijazat nahin milti agar kisi bare gharane mein nikah ki mang kar dalein toh wahan ki beti nahin milti. In maskinon se insaf ke burtao nahin barte jate. Inki hajatein aur inki umangein aur muradein puri hone se pehle hi khud hi faut ho jati hain aur arzuwein dil ke dil mein hi reh jati hain unhein qiyamat ke din is qadr noor milega ki agar woh taqseem kiya jaye toh tamam duniya ke liye kafi ho jayega. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mubarak ke sheron mein hai ki bahut se woh log jo duniya mein haqir-o-zalil samjhe jate hain kal qiyamat ke din takht-o-taraj wale mulk-o-manal wale izzat-o-jalal wale bane hue honge. Baghat mein nehron mein nematon mein rahatan mein mashghool honge. Rasool Kareem ﷺ farmate hain ki Janab-e-Bari ka irshad hai sabse zyada mera pasandida wali woh hai jo momin ho kam maal wala kam ayal wala ghazi ibadat-o-itaat guzar poshida-o-alania moti ho logon mein uski izzat aur uska waqar na ho uski janib ungliyan uthti hon aur woh is par sabir ho phir Huzoor ﷺ ne apne hath jhad kar farmaya uski maut jaldi aa jati hai uski miras bahut kam hoti hai uski rone waliyan thodi hoti hain. Farmate hain Allah ke sabse zyada mahbub bande ghurba hain jo apne deen ko liye phirte hain jahan deen ke kamzor hone ka khatra hota hai wahan se nikal khade hote hain yeh qiyamat ke din Hazrat Isa Alaihis Salam ke sath jama honge. Hazrat Fuzail bin Ayyaz ka qaul hai ki mujhe yeh baat maloom hui hai ki Allah Ta'ala qiyamat ke din apne bande se farmayega kya main ne tujh par inaam-o-ikram nahin farmaya ? Kya main ne tujhe diya nahin ? Kya main ne tera jism nahin dhanpa ? Kya main ne tumhein yeh nahin diya ? Kya woh nahin diya ? Kya logon mein tujhe izzat nahin di thi ? Waghaira toh jahan tak hoske in sawalon ke jawab dene ka mauqa kam mile acha hai. Logon ki tareefon se kya fayda aur mazammat karein toh kya nuqsan hoga. Hamare nazdeek toh woh shakhs zyada acha hai jise log bura kehte hon aur woh Allah ke nazdeek acha ho. Ibn Muhiriz toh dua karte the ki Allah meri shohrat na ho.

Khalil bin Ahmad apni dua mein kehte thay Allah mujhe apni nigahon mein tu bulandi ata farma aur khud meri nazar mein mujhe bohat haqeer karde aur logon ki nigahon mein mujhe darmiyana darja ka rakh phir shohrat ka baab baandh kar Imam sahib is hadith ko laaye hain insan ko yehi burai kafi hai ke log is ki deendari ya duniya dari ki shohrat dene lagein aur is ki taraf ungliyan uthne lagein isharay hone lagein. Pas isi mein akar bohat se log halak hojate hain magar jinhein Allah bacha le. Suno Allah Ta'ala tumhari soortoon ko nahi dekhta balki woh tumhare dilon aur amaalon ko dekhta hai. Hazrat Hasan se bhi yehi riwayat mursalan marwi hai jab aap ne yeh riwayat bayan ki to kisi ne kaha aap ki taraf bhi ungliyan uthti hain. Aap ne farmaya samjhe nahi murad ungliyan uthne se deeni bid'at ya duniyawi fisq-o-fujoor hai. Hazrat Ali R.A ka farman hai ke shohrat hasil karna na chaho. Apne tayin ooncha na karo ke logon mein tazkare hone lagein ilm hasil karo lekin chupao chup raho taake salamat raho nekon ko khush rakho badkaron se tasarruf rakho. Hazrat Ibrahim bin Adham farmate hain ke shohrat ka chahne wala Allah ka wali nahi hota. Hazrat Ayyub ka farman hai jise Allah dost bana leta hai woh to logon se apna darja chupata hai. Muhammad bin Ala farmate hain Allah ke dost log apne tayin zahir nahi karte. Samak bin Salma ka qool hai aam logon ke mel jol se aur ahbab ki ziyadati se parhez karo. Hazrat Aban bin Usman farmate hain agar deen ko salim rakhna chahte ho to logon se kam jaan pehchan rakho. Hazrat Abul Aliyah ka qaida tha jab dekhte ke unki majlis mein teen se ziyada log jama hogaye to unhein chhor kar khud chal dete. Hazrat Talha R.A khare thay Hazrat Umar R.A ne kora tana aur farmaya is mein tabe ke liye zillat aur matboo ke liye fitna hai. Hazrat Ibn Masood R.A ke sath jab log chalne lage to aap ne farmaya ke agar tum par mera batin zahir hojaye to tum mein se do bhi mere sath chalna pasand na karein. Hammad bin Zaid kehte hain jab hum kisi majlis ke paas se guzarte aur hamare sath Ayyub hote to salam karte aur woh sakhti se jawab dete. Pas yeh ek nemat thi. Aap lambi qameez pehnte us par logon ne kaha to aap ne jawab diya ke agle zamane mein shohrat ki cheez thi. Lekin yeh shohrat is ko ooncha karne mein hai. Ek martba aap ne apni topiyan masnoon rang ki rangwai aur kuch dinon tak pehn kar utar di aur farmaya maine dekha ke log unhein nahi pehnte. Hazrat Ibrahim Nakhai ka qool hai ke na to aisa libas pehno ke logon ki ungli

Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ka maqoola hai ke aap ne Bani Israel se farmaya mere saamne to darweshon ki poshakh mein aaye halanki tumhare dil bheriyon jaise hain. Suno libas chahe badshahon jaisa pehno magar dil khauf-e-Khuda se naram rakho. 

Achhe akhlaq ka bayan: Huzoor ﷺ sab se behtar akhlaq wale thay. Aap se sawal hua ke konsa momin behtar hai? Farmaya sab se achhe akhlaq wala. Aap ka farman hai ke bawajood kam aamal ke sirf achhe akhlaq ki wajah se insan bare bare darje aur Jannat ke aala manazil hasil kar leta hai. Aur bawajood bohat sari nekiyon ke sirf akhlaq ki burayi ki wajah se Jahannam ke niche ke tabqe mein chala jata hai. Farmate hain achhe akhlaq hi mein dunya akhirat ki bhalai hai. Farmate hain insan apni khush-akhlaqi ke bais raton ko qiyam karne wale aur dinon ko roze rakhne walon ke darjon ko pa leta hai. 

Huzoor ﷺ se sawal hua ke dakhool-e-Jannat ka mojib aam taur se kya hai? Farmaya Allah ka dar aur akhlaq ki achhayi. Pucha gaya aam taur se Jahannam mein konsi cheez le jati hai? Farmaya do surakh-dar cheezein yani munh aur sharmgah. 

Ek martaba chand a'rab ke is sawal par ke insan ko sab se behtar atiya kya mila hai? Farmaya ke husn-e-akhlaq. Farmaya ke neki ki tarazu mein achhe akhlaq se zyada wazni cheez aur koi nahi. Farmate hain tum mein se sab se behtar woh hai jo sab se achhe akhlaq wala hai. Farmate hain jis tarah mujahid ko Allah ki rah mein jihad karne par subh sham ajar milta hai usi tarah achhe akhlaq par bhi Allah sawab ata farmata hai. 

Irshad hai tum mein mujhe sab se zyada mahboob aur sab se zyada qareeb woh hai jo sab se achhe akhlaq wala hai. Mere nazdeek sab se zyada bughz-o-nafrat ke qabil aur mujh se sab se door Jannat mein woh hoga jo bad-khlaq, bad-go, bad-kalam, bad-zaban hoga. 

Farmate hain kamil imandar achhe akhlaq wale hain jo har ek se sulook-o-mohabbat se milen jilen. Irshad hai jis ki paidaish aur akhlaq achhe hain use Allah Ta'ala Jahannam ka luqma nahi banayega. Irshad hai ke do khaslatein momin mein jama nahi ho saktin; bukhl aur bad-akhlaqi. 

Farmate hain bad-akhlaqi se zyada bara koi gunah nahi. Is liye ke bad-akhlaqi se insan ek se ek bare gunah mein mubtila ho jata hai. Huzoor ka irshad hai Allah ke nazdeek bad-akhlaqi se bara koi gunah nahi. Achhe akhlaq se gunah maaf ho jate hain. Bad-akhlaqiyan naik aamalon ko gharat kar deti hain. Jaise shehad ko sirka kharab kar deta hai. 

Huzoor farmate hain ke ghulam khareedne se ghulam nahi barhte albatta khush-akhlaqi se log grovida ho jate hain. Imam Muhammad bin Sireen ka qaul hai ke achha khulaq deen ki madad hai.

Takabbur ki muzammat ka bayan: Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain woh Jannat mein na jayega jis ke dil mein rai ke dane ke barabar takabbur ho. Aur woh jahannami nahi jis ke dil mein rai ke barabar iman ho. Farmate hain ke jis ke dil mein ek zarre ke barabar takabbur hai woh andhe munh Jahannam mein jayenge. Irshad hai ke insan apne ghuroor aur khud-pasandi mein barhte barhte Allah ke haan jabbaron mein likh diya jata hai.

Phir sarkashon ke azab mein phans jata hai. Imam Malik bin Dinar Rahimahullah farmate hain ek din Hazrat Sulaiman bin Daud A.S apne takht par baithe the aap ke darbar mein us waqt do lakh insan the aur do lakh jin the aap ko aasman tak pohanchaya gaya yahan tak ke farishton ki tasbih ki aawaz kaan mein aane lagi. Aur phir zameen tak laya gaya yahan tak ke samandar ke pani se aap ke qadam bheeg gaye. Phir hatif-e-ghaib ne neda di ke agar is ke dil mein ek dane ke barabar bhi takabbur hota to jitna ooncha gaya tha us se zyada neeche dhansa diya jata. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique R.A ne apne khutbe mein insan ki ibtidai paidaish ka bayan karte hue farmaya ke yeh do shakhson ki peshab-gah se nikalta hai. Is tarah ise bayan farmaya ke sunne wale karahat karne lage. Imam Sha'abi ka qaul hai jis ne do shakhson ko qatal kar diya woh bada hi sarkash aur jabbar hai phir aap ne yeh aayat padhi (Atureedu an taqtulani kama qatalta nafsan bil-ams 19) (28. Al-Qasas: 19) Kya tu mujhe qatal karna chahta hai? Jaise ke tu ne kal ek shakhs ko qatal kiya hai. Tera irada to duniya mein sarkash aur jabbar ban kar rehne ka maloom hota hai. Hazrat Hasan ka maqula hai woh insan jo har din mein do martaba apna pakhana apne hath se dhota hai woh kis bina par takabbur karta hai aur is ka wasf apne mein paida karna chahta hai jis ne aasmaanon ko paida kiya hai aur apne qabze mein rakha hai. Zahhak bin Sufyan se duniya ki misaal us cheez se bhi marwi hai jo insan se nikalti hai. Imam Muhammad bin Husain bin Ali farmate hain jis dil mein jitna takabbur aur ghamand hota hai utni hi aql uski kam ho jati hai. Yunus bin Ubaid farmate hain ke sajda karne ke sath takabbur aur tauhid ke sath nifaq nahi hua karta. Bani Umayyah maar maar kar apni aulad ko akda kar chalna sikhate the. Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz ko aap ki khilafat se pehle ek martaba uthlati hui chaal chalte hue dekh kar Hazrat Tawus ne unke pehlu mein ek thonka mara aur farmaya yeh chaal uski hai jis ke pait mein pakhana bhara hua hai? Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz bahut sharminda hue aur kehne lage maaf farmaiye hamein maar maar kar is chaal ki aadat dalwai gayi hai. Fakr-o-ghamand ki mazammat ka bayan: Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain jo shakhs fakr-o-ghuroor se apna kapda neeche latka kar ghaseetega Allah Ta'ala qayamat ke din uski taraf rehmat se na dekhega. Farmate hain iski taraf Allah qayamat ke din nazar na daalega jo apna tahband latkaye. Ek shakhs do umda chadrein odhe dil mein ghuroor liye akadta hua ja raha tha ke Allah Ta'ala ne ise zameen mein dhansa diya qayamat tak woh dhanta hua chala jayega.

Qiyamat ke din aala akhlaq kaam aaye ga. Hazrat Luqman ki yeh aur Wasiyatein hain aur chunke yeh sab hikmaton se pur hain, Quran unhein bayaan farma raha hai taake log un par amal karein. Farmate hain ke burai khata zulm hai chahe rai ke daane ke barabar bhi ho, phir woh khana hi posheeda aur dhaka chupa kyun na ho, Qiyamat ke din Allah use pesh karega, mizan mein sab ko rakha jayega aur badla diya jayega, naik kaam par jaza aur bad par saza, jaise farman hai: Ayat (WANADA’UL MAWAZINAL QISHTA LILYOUMIL QIYAMATI FALA TUZLAMU NAFSUN SHAIAN) (21. Al-Anbiya: 47), yaani Qiyamat ke din adl ke tarazu rakh kar har ek ko badla denge, koi zulm na kiya jayega. Aur aikat mein hai zarre barabar neki aur zarre barabar burai har ek dekh lega, khwa woh neki ya badi kisi makan mein, mahal mein, qila mein, pathar ke sorakh mein, asmanon ke konon mein, zameen ki teh mein ho, kahin bhi ho Allah Ta'ala se makhfi nahi, woh use la kar pesh karega, woh bare bareek ilm wala hai. Chhoti se chhoti cheez bhi us par zahir hai, andheri raat mein cheenti jo chal rahi ho us ke paon ki aahat ka bhi woh ilm rakhta hai. Baaz ne yeh bhi jaiz rakha hai ke inna mein zameer-e-shaan ki aur qissa ki hai aur is bina par unhon ne misqal ki laam ka pesh parhna bhi jaiz rakha hai lekin pehli baat hi zyada achhi hai. Baaz kehte hain ke sakhra se murad woh pathar hai jo satween asman aur zameen ke niche hain, is ki baaz sanadein bhi Bani Israel se hain agar sahih sabit ho jayein, baaz Sahaba se marwi to hai Wallahu A'lam. Bohat mumkin hai ke yeh bhi Bani Israel se manqool ho lekin un ki kitabon ki kisi baat ko hum na sachi maan sakein na jhutla sakein. Ba-zahir yeh maloom hota hai ke ba-qadar rai ke daane ke koi amal haqeer ho aur aisa posheeda ho ke kisi pathar ke andar ho, jaise Musnad Ahmad ki hadith mein hai Rasoolullah ﷺ farmate hain: Agar tum mein se koi shakhs koi amal kare kisi be-sorakh ke pathar ke andar jis ka na koi darwaza ho na khirki ho na sorakh ho, taham Allah Ta'ala use logon par zahir kar dega khwa kuch hi amal ho naik ho ya bad. Phir farmate hain: Bete namaz ka khayal rakhna, is ke faraiz, is ke wajibat, arkaan, auqaat waghera ki poori hifazat karna, apni taqat ke mutabiq poori koshish karna, sath Allah ki baton ki tabligh apnon parayon mein karte rehna, bhali baatein karne aur buri baton se bachne ke liye har ek se kehna aur chunke neki ka hukam yani badi se rokna jo عموماً logon ko karwi lagti hai aur haq-go shakhs se log dushmani rakhte hain is liye sath hi farmaya ke logon se jo eza aur museebat pahuche us par sabr karna, dar-haqeeqat Allah ki raah mein nangi shamshir rehna aur haq par museebatein jhelte hue past himmat na hona yeh bara bhaari aur jawanmardi ka kaam hai. Phir farmate hain: Apna munh logon se na mor, unhein haqeer samajh kar ya apne taiy bara samajh kar logon se takabbur na kar, balke narmi barat, khush-khulqi se pesh aa, khanda-peshani se baat kar.

Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai ke kisi Musalman bhai se tu kushada peshani se hans mukh ho kar mile yeh bhi teri bari neki hai. Tahband aur pajame ko takhne se neecha na kar yeh kibr-o-ghuroor hai aur Allah ko naپسand [na-pasand] hai. Hazrat Luqman ne apne bete ko takbur na karne ki wasiyat ki hai ke aisa na ho ke Allah ke bandon ko haqeer samajh kar tu un se munh mor le aur miskeenon se baat karne se sharmaye. Munh more hue baatein karna bhi ghuroor mein dakhil hai. Bachhein phaar kar lehja badal kar hakimana andaz ke sath ghumanD bhare alfaaz se baat-cheet bhi mamnoo hai. Sa'ar aik beemari hai jo oonton ki gardan mein zahir hoti hai ya sar mein aur is se gardan terhi ho jati hai, pas mutakabbir shakhs ko isi terhe munh wale shakhs se mila diya gaya. Arab umoman takbur ke moqe par sa'ar ka istemal karte hain aur yeh istemal un ke sheron mein bhi mojood hai. Zameen par tan kar akar kar utra kar ghuroor-o-takbur se na chalo yeh chaal Allah ko na-pasand hai. Allah Ta'ala un logon ko na-pasand rakhta hai jo khud-been, mutakabbir, sarkash aur fakhr-o-ghuroor karne wale hon aur ayat mein hai (Wa la tamshi fil ardi marahan, innaka lan takhriqal arda wa lan tablughal jibala toola 37) (17. Al-Isra: 37), yaani akar kar zameen par na chalo na to tum zameen ko phaar sakte ho na paharon ki lambai ko pahunch sakte ho. Is ayat ki tafsir bhi iski jagah guzar chuki hai. Huzoor ﷺ ke samne aik martaba takbur ka zikr kiya gaya to Aap ﷺ ne iski bari mazammat farmai aur farmaya ke aise khud-pasand maghroor logon se Allah ghussa hota hai, is par aik Sahabi ne kaha Ya Rasoolallah ﷺ main jab kapre dhoota hoon aur khoob safed ho jate hain to mujhe bohat achhe lagte hain main un se khush hota hoon. Isi tarah jootey mein tasma bhala lagta hai. Kore ka khoobsurat ghilaf bhala maloom hota hai, Aap ﷺ ne farmaya yeh takbur nahi hai, takbur iska naam hai ke tu haq ko haqeer samjhe aur logon ko zaleel khayal kare. Yeh riwayat aur tareeq se bohat lambi marwi hai aur is mein Hazrat Sabit ke intiqal aur un ki wasiyat ka zikr bhi hai. Aur miyana-rawi ki chaal chal kar na bohat ahista kharaman kharaman na bohat jaldi lambe dak bhar bhar ke. Kalam mein mubaligha na kare, be-faida chekh chilla nahi. Badtareen awaz gadhe ki hai. Jo poori taqat laga kar be-sood chalata hai. Bawajood-ike woh bhi Allah ke samne apni aajizi zahir karta hai. Pas yeh buri misaal de kar samjha diya ke bila-wajah chekhna, dant-dapat karna haram hai. Rasoolallah ﷺ farmate hain buri misalon ke layak hum nahi. Apni de di hui cheez wapas lene wala aisa hai jaise kutta jo qai kar ke chaat leta hai. Nasai mein is ayat ki tafsir mein hai ke Rasoolallah ﷺ ne farmaya jab murgh ki awaz suno to Allah Ta'ala se uska fazal talab karo aur jab gadhe ki awaz suno to Allah Ta'ala se panah talab karo. Is liye ke woh Shaitan ko dekhta hai. Aik riwayat mein hai raat ko. Wallahu A'lam. Yeh wasiyatein Hazrat Luqman Hakim ki nihayat hi nafeh-bakhsh hain. Quran-e-Hakim ne isi liye bayan farmai hain.

Aap se aur bhi bohat hakeemana qaul aur wa'z-o-naseehat ke kalmaat marwi hain. Batour namoonah ke aur dastoor ke hum bhi thore se bayan karte hain. Musnad Ahmad mein ba-zaban-e-Rasoolullah ﷺ Hazrat Luqman Hakeem ka aik qaul yeh bhi marwi hai ke Allah ko jab koi cheez saunp di jaye Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala us ki hifazat karta hai. Aur hadees mein aap ka yeh qaul bhi marwi hai ke tasannu se bach yeh raat ke waqt darauni cheez hai aur din ko mazammat-o-burai wali cheez hai. Aap ne apne bete se yeh bhi farmaya tha ke hikmat se maskeen log baadshah ban jate hain. Aap ka farman hai ke jab kisi majlis mein pahuncho pehle Islami tareeq ke mutabiq salam karo phir majlis ke aik taraf baith jao. Doosre na bole to tum bhi khamosh raho. Agar woh zikrullah karein to tum un mein sab se pehle zyada hissa lene ki koshish karo. Aur agar woh gup shap karein to tum us majlis ko chhod do. Marwi hai ke aap apne bachche ko naseehat karne ke liye jab baithte to rai ki bhari hui aik thaili apne paas rakh lete the aur har har naseehat ke baad aik daana us mein se nikaal lete yahan tak ke thaili khali hogayi to aap ne farmaya bachche agar itni naseehat kisi pahaad ko karta to woh bhi tukde tukde hojata. Chunancha aap ke sahibzade ka bhi yahi haal hua. Rasoolullah ﷺ farmate hain Habshiyon ko rakha karo un mein se teen shakhs ahl-e-jannat ke sardar hain, Luqman Hakeem, Najashi aur Bilal moazzin.
Tawazu aur forutani ka bayan: Hazrat Luqman ne apne bachche ko is ki wasiyat ki thi aur Ibn Abi Dunya ne is masle par aik mustaqil kitab likhi hai. Hum us mein se ahem baatein yahan zikr kar dete hain. Rasoolullah ﷺ farmate hain bohat se paraganda baalon wale, maile kocheele kapdon wale jo kisi bare ghar tak nahi pahunch sakte Allah ke haan itne bare martaba wale hain ke agar woh Allah par koi qasam laga baithein to Allah Ta'ala use bhi poori farma de. Aur hadees mein hai Bara bin Malik aise hi logon mein se hain (R.A). Aik martiba Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne Hazrat Mu'az (R.A) ko qabr-e-Rasool ke paas rote dekh kar daryaft farmaya to jawab mila ke sahib-e-qabr ﷺ se aik hadees main ne suni hai jise yaad karke ro raha hoon. Main ne aap se suna farmate the thori si riyakari bhi shirk hai. Allah Ta'ala unhe dost rakhta hai jo muttaqi hain, jo logon mein chupe chupaye hain, jo kisi ginti mein nahi aate, agar woh kisi majma' mein na hon to koi un ka pursan-e-haal nahi, agar aa jayein to koi aao bhagat nahi lekin un ke dil hidayat ke chiragh hain, woh har aik ghubaar alood andhere se bach kar noor hasil kar lete hain. Huzoor farmate hain yeh maile kocheele kapdon wale jo zaleel gine jate hain Allah ke haan aise muqarrab hain ke agar Allah par qasam kha baithein to Allah poori kar de, go unhe Allah ne duniya nahi di lekin un ki zuban se poori jannat ka sawal bhi nikal jaye to Allah poora kar leta hai.

Aap farmate hain ki meri ummat mein aise log bhi hain ki agar tum mein se kisi ke darwaze par aakar woh log ek dinar ek dirham balki ek fulus bhi mangein toh tum na do lekin Allah ke han woh aise pyare hain ki agar Allah se jannat ki jannat mangein toh Parwardigar de de haan duniya na toh unhein deta hai na rokta hai is liye ki yeh koi qabil-e-qadr cheez nahin. Yeh maile kachhile do chadoron mein rehte hain agar kisi mauqe par qasam kha baithein toh jo qasam unhon ne khai ho Allah puri karta hai. Huzoor farmate hain ki jannat ke badshah log hain jo paraganda aur bikhre hue balon wale hain ghubar alud aur gard se atte hue woh amiron ke ghar jana chahein toh unhein ijazat nahin milti agar kisi bare gharane mein nikah ki mang kar dalein toh wahan ki beti nahin milti. In maskinon se insaf ke burtao nahin barte jate. Inki hajatein aur inki umangein aur muradein puri hone se pehle hi khud hi faut ho jati hain aur arzuwein dil ke dil mein hi reh jati hain unhein qiyamat ke din is qadr noor milega ki agar woh taqseem kiya jaye toh tamam duniya ke liye kafi ho jayega. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mubarak ke sheron mein hai ki bahut se woh log jo duniya mein haqir-o-zalil samjhe jate hain kal qiyamat ke din takht-o-taraj wale mulk-o-manal wale izzat-o-jalal wale bane hue honge. Baghat mein nehron mein nematon mein rahatan mein mashghool honge. Rasool Kareem ﷺ farmate hain ki Janab-e-Bari ka irshad hai sabse zyada mera pasandida wali woh hai jo momin ho kam maal wala kam ayal wala ghazi ibadat-o-itaat guzar poshida-o-alania moti ho logon mein uski izzat aur uska waqar na ho uski janib ungliyan uthti hon aur woh is par sabir ho phir Huzoor ﷺ ne apne hath jhad kar farmaya uski maut jaldi aa jati hai uski miras bahut kam hoti hai uski rone waliyan thodi hoti hain. Farmate hain Allah ke sabse zyada mahbub bande ghurba hain jo apne deen ko liye phirte hain jahan deen ke kamzor hone ka khatra hota hai wahan se nikal khade hote hain yeh qiyamat ke din Hazrat Isa Alaihis Salam ke sath jama honge. Hazrat Fuzail bin Ayyaz ka qaul hai ki mujhe yeh baat maloom hui hai ki Allah Ta'ala qiyamat ke din apne bande se farmayega kya main ne tujh par inaam-o-ikram nahin farmaya ? Kya main ne tujhe diya nahin ? Kya main ne tera jism nahin dhanpa ? Kya main ne tumhein yeh nahin diya ? Kya woh nahin diya ? Kya logon mein tujhe izzat nahin di thi ? Waghaira toh jahan tak hoske in sawalon ke jawab dene ka mauqa kam mile acha hai. Logon ki tareefon se kya fayda aur mazammat karein toh kya nuqsan hoga. Hamare nazdeek toh woh shakhs zyada acha hai jise log bura kehte hon aur woh Allah ke nazdeek acha ho. Ibn Muhiriz toh dua karte the ki Allah meri shohrat na ho.

Khalil bin Ahmad apni dua mein kehte thay Allah mujhe apni nigahon mein tu bulandi ata farma aur khud meri nazar mein mujhe bohat haqeer karde aur logon ki nigahon mein mujhe darmiyana darja ka rakh phir shohrat ka baab baandh kar Imam sahib is hadith ko laaye hain insan ko yehi burai kafi hai ke log is ki deendari ya duniya dari ki shohrat dene lagein aur is ki taraf ungliyan uthne lagein isharay hone lagein. Pas isi mein akar bohat se log halak hojate hain magar jinhein Allah bacha le. Suno Allah Ta'ala tumhari soortoon ko nahi dekhta balki woh tumhare dilon aur amaalon ko dekhta hai. Hazrat Hasan se bhi yehi riwayat mursalan marwi hai jab aap ne yeh riwayat bayan ki to kisi ne kaha aap ki taraf bhi ungliyan uthti hain. Aap ne farmaya samjhe nahi murad ungliyan uthne se deeni bid'at ya duniyawi fisq-o-fujoor hai. Hazrat Ali R.A ka farman hai ke shohrat hasil karna na chaho. Apne tayin ooncha na karo ke logon mein tazkare hone lagein ilm hasil karo lekin chupao chup raho taake salamat raho nekon ko khush rakho badkaron se tasarruf rakho. Hazrat Ibrahim bin Adham farmate hain ke shohrat ka chahne wala Allah ka wali nahi hota. Hazrat Ayyub ka farman hai jise Allah dost bana leta hai woh to logon se apna darja chupata hai. Muhammad bin Ala farmate hain Allah ke dost log apne tayin zahir nahi karte. Samak bin Salma ka qool hai aam logon ke mel jol se aur ahbab ki ziyadati se parhez karo. Hazrat Aban bin Usman farmate hain agar deen ko salim rakhna chahte ho to logon se kam jaan pehchan rakho. Hazrat Abul Aliyah ka qaida tha jab dekhte ke unki majlis mein teen se ziyada log jama hogaye to unhein chhor kar khud chal dete. Hazrat Talha R.A khare thay Hazrat Umar R.A ne kora tana aur farmaya is mein tabe ke liye zillat aur matboo ke liye fitna hai. Hazrat Ibn Masood R.A ke sath jab log chalne lage to aap ne farmaya ke agar tum par mera batin zahir hojaye to tum mein se do bhi mere sath chalna pasand na karein. Hammad bin Zaid kehte hain jab hum kisi majlis ke paas se guzarte aur hamare sath Ayyub hote to salam karte aur woh sakhti se jawab dete. Pas yeh ek nemat thi. Aap lambi qameez pehnte us par logon ne kaha to aap ne jawab diya ke agle zamane mein shohrat ki cheez thi. Lekin yeh shohrat is ko ooncha karne mein hai. Ek martba aap ne apni topiyan masnoon rang ki rangwai aur kuch dinon tak pehn kar utar di aur farmaya maine dekha ke log unhein nahi pehnte. Hazrat Ibrahim Nakhai ka qool hai ke na to aisa libas pehno ke logon ki ungli

Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ka maqoola hai ke aap ne Bani Israel se farmaya mere saamne to darweshon ki poshakh mein aaye halanki tumhare dil bheriyon jaise hain. Suno libas chahe badshahon jaisa pehno magar dil khauf-e-Khuda se naram rakho. 

Achhe akhlaq ka bayan: Huzoor ﷺ sab se behtar akhlaq wale thay. Aap se sawal hua ke konsa momin behtar hai? Farmaya sab se achhe akhlaq wala. Aap ka farman hai ke bawajood kam aamal ke sirf achhe akhlaq ki wajah se insan bare bare darje aur Jannat ke aala manazil hasil kar leta hai. Aur bawajood bohat sari nekiyon ke sirf akhlaq ki burayi ki wajah se Jahannam ke niche ke tabqe mein chala jata hai. Farmate hain achhe akhlaq hi mein dunya akhirat ki bhalai hai. Farmate hain insan apni khush-akhlaqi ke bais raton ko qiyam karne wale aur dinon ko roze rakhne walon ke darjon ko pa leta hai. 

Huzoor ﷺ se sawal hua ke dakhool-e-Jannat ka mojib aam taur se kya hai? Farmaya Allah ka dar aur akhlaq ki achhayi. Pucha gaya aam taur se Jahannam mein konsi cheez le jati hai? Farmaya do surakh-dar cheezein yani munh aur sharmgah. 

Ek martaba chand a'rab ke is sawal par ke insan ko sab se behtar atiya kya mila hai? Farmaya ke husn-e-akhlaq. Farmaya ke neki ki tarazu mein achhe akhlaq se zyada wazni cheez aur koi nahi. Farmate hain tum mein se sab se behtar woh hai jo sab se achhe akhlaq wala hai. Farmate hain jis tarah mujahid ko Allah ki rah mein jihad karne par subh sham ajar milta hai usi tarah achhe akhlaq par bhi Allah sawab ata farmata hai. 

Irshad hai tum mein mujhe sab se zyada mahboob aur sab se zyada qareeb woh hai jo sab se achhe akhlaq wala hai. Mere nazdeek sab se zyada bughz-o-nafrat ke qabil aur mujh se sab se door Jannat mein woh hoga jo bad-khlaq, bad-go, bad-kalam, bad-zaban hoga. 

Farmate hain kamil imandar achhe akhlaq wale hain jo har ek se sulook-o-mohabbat se milen jilen. Irshad hai jis ki paidaish aur akhlaq achhe hain use Allah Ta'ala Jahannam ka luqma nahi banayega. Irshad hai ke do khaslatein momin mein jama nahi ho saktin; bukhl aur bad-akhlaqi. 

Farmate hain bad-akhlaqi se zyada bara koi gunah nahi. Is liye ke bad-akhlaqi se insan ek se ek bare gunah mein mubtila ho jata hai. Huzoor ka irshad hai Allah ke nazdeek bad-akhlaqi se bara koi gunah nahi. Achhe akhlaq se gunah maaf ho jate hain. Bad-akhlaqiyan naik aamalon ko gharat kar deti hain. Jaise shehad ko sirka kharab kar deta hai. 

Huzoor farmate hain ke ghulam khareedne se ghulam nahi barhte albatta khush-akhlaqi se log grovida ho jate hain. Imam Muhammad bin Sireen ka qaul hai ke achha khulaq deen ki madad hai.

Takabbur ki muzammat ka bayan: Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain woh Jannat mein na jayega jis ke dil mein rai ke dane ke barabar takabbur ho. Aur woh jahannami nahi jis ke dil mein rai ke barabar iman ho. Farmate hain ke jis ke dil mein ek zarre ke barabar takabbur hai woh andhe munh Jahannam mein jayenge. Irshad hai ke insan apne ghuroor aur khud-pasandi mein barhte barhte Allah ke haan jabbaron mein likh diya jata hai.

Phir sarkashon ke azab mein phans jata hai. Imam Malik bin Dinar Rahimahullah farmate hain ek din Hazrat Sulaiman bin Daud A.S apne takht par baithe the aap ke darbar mein us waqt do lakh insan the aur do lakh jin the aap ko aasman tak pohanchaya gaya yahan tak ke farishton ki tasbih ki aawaz kaan mein aane lagi. Aur phir zameen tak laya gaya yahan tak ke samandar ke pani se aap ke qadam bheeg gaye. Phir hatif-e-ghaib ne neda di ke agar is ke dil mein ek dane ke barabar bhi takabbur hota to jitna ooncha gaya tha us se zyada neeche dhansa diya jata. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique R.A ne apne khutbe mein insan ki ibtidai paidaish ka bayan karte hue farmaya ke yeh do shakhson ki peshab-gah se nikalta hai. Is tarah ise bayan farmaya ke sunne wale karahat karne lage. Imam Sha'abi ka qaul hai jis ne do shakhson ko qatal kar diya woh bada hi sarkash aur jabbar hai phir aap ne yeh aayat padhi (Atureedu an taqtulani kama qatalta nafsan bil-ams 19) (28. Al-Qasas: 19) Kya tu mujhe qatal karna chahta hai? Jaise ke tu ne kal ek shakhs ko qatal kiya hai. Tera irada to duniya mein sarkash aur jabbar ban kar rehne ka maloom hota hai. Hazrat Hasan ka maqula hai woh insan jo har din mein do martaba apna pakhana apne hath se dhota hai woh kis bina par takabbur karta hai aur is ka wasf apne mein paida karna chahta hai jis ne aasmaanon ko paida kiya hai aur apne qabze mein rakha hai. Zahhak bin Sufyan se duniya ki misaal us cheez se bhi marwi hai jo insan se nikalti hai. Imam Muhammad bin Husain bin Ali farmate hain jis dil mein jitna takabbur aur ghamand hota hai utni hi aql uski kam ho jati hai. Yunus bin Ubaid farmate hain ke sajda karne ke sath takabbur aur tauhid ke sath nifaq nahi hua karta. Bani Umayyah maar maar kar apni aulad ko akda kar chalna sikhate the. Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz ko aap ki khilafat se pehle ek martaba uthlati hui chaal chalte hue dekh kar Hazrat Tawus ne unke pehlu mein ek thonka mara aur farmaya yeh chaal uski hai jis ke pait mein pakhana bhara hua hai? Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz bahut sharminda hue aur kehne lage maaf farmaiye hamein maar maar kar is chaal ki aadat dalwai gayi hai. Fakr-o-ghamand ki mazammat ka bayan: Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain jo shakhs fakr-o-ghuroor se apna kapda neeche latka kar ghaseetega Allah Ta'ala qayamat ke din uski taraf rehmat se na dekhega. Farmate hain iski taraf Allah qayamat ke din nazar na daalega jo apna tahband latkaye. Ek shakhs do umda chadrein odhe dil mein ghuroor liye akadta hua ja raha tha ke Allah Ta'ala ne ise zameen mein dhansa diya qayamat tak woh dhanta hua chala jayega.

Qiyamat ke din aala akhlaq kaam aaye ga. Hazrat Luqman ki yeh aur Wasiyatein hain aur chunke yeh sab hikmaton se pur hain, Quran unhein bayaan farma raha hai taake log un par amal karein. Farmate hain ke burai khata zulm hai chahe rai ke daane ke barabar bhi ho, phir woh khana hi posheeda aur dhaka chupa kyun na ho, Qiyamat ke din Allah use pesh karega, mizan mein sab ko rakha jayega aur badla diya jayega, naik kaam par jaza aur bad par saza, jaise farman hai: Ayat (WANADA’UL MAWAZINAL QISHTA LILYOUMIL QIYAMATI FALA TUZLAMU NAFSUN SHAIAN) (21. Al-Anbiya: 47), yaani Qiyamat ke din adl ke tarazu rakh kar har ek ko badla denge, koi zulm na kiya jayega. Aur aikat mein hai zarre barabar neki aur zarre barabar burai har ek dekh lega, khwa woh neki ya badi kisi makan mein, mahal mein, qila mein, pathar ke sorakh mein, asmanon ke konon mein, zameen ki teh mein ho, kahin bhi ho Allah Ta'ala se makhfi nahi, woh use la kar pesh karega, woh bare bareek ilm wala hai. Chhoti se chhoti cheez bhi us par zahir hai, andheri raat mein cheenti jo chal rahi ho us ke paon ki aahat ka bhi woh ilm rakhta hai. Baaz ne yeh bhi jaiz rakha hai ke inna mein zameer-e-shaan ki aur qissa ki hai aur is bina par unhon ne misqal ki laam ka pesh parhna bhi jaiz rakha hai lekin pehli baat hi zyada achhi hai. Baaz kehte hain ke sakhra se murad woh pathar hai jo satween asman aur zameen ke niche hain, is ki baaz sanadein bhi Bani Israel se hain agar sahih sabit ho jayein, baaz Sahaba se marwi to hai Wallahu A'lam. Bohat mumkin hai ke yeh bhi Bani Israel se manqool ho lekin un ki kitabon ki kisi baat ko hum na sachi maan sakein na jhutla sakein. Ba-zahir yeh maloom hota hai ke ba-qadar rai ke daane ke koi amal haqeer ho aur aisa posheeda ho ke kisi pathar ke andar ho, jaise Musnad Ahmad ki hadith mein hai Rasoolullah ﷺ farmate hain: Agar tum mein se koi shakhs koi amal kare kisi be-sorakh ke pathar ke andar jis ka na koi darwaza ho na khirki ho na sorakh ho, taham Allah Ta'ala use logon par zahir kar dega khwa kuch hi amal ho naik ho ya bad. Phir farmate hain: Bete namaz ka khayal rakhna, is ke faraiz, is ke wajibat, arkaan, auqaat waghera ki poori hifazat karna, apni taqat ke mutabiq poori koshish karna, sath Allah ki baton ki tabligh apnon parayon mein karte rehna, bhali baatein karne aur buri baton se bachne ke liye har ek se kehna aur chunke neki ka hukam yani badi se rokna jo عموماً logon ko karwi lagti hai aur haq-go shakhs se log dushmani rakhte hain is liye sath hi farmaya ke logon se jo eza aur museebat pahuche us par sabr karna, dar-haqeeqat Allah ki raah mein nangi shamshir rehna aur haq par museebatein jhelte hue past himmat na hona yeh bara bhaari aur jawanmardi ka kaam hai. Phir farmate hain: Apna munh logon se na mor, unhein haqeer samajh kar ya apne taiy bara samajh kar logon se takabbur na kar, balke narmi barat, khush-khulqi se pesh aa, khanda-peshani se baat kar.

Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai ke kisi Musalman bhai se tu kushada peshani se hans mukh ho kar mile yeh bhi teri bari neki hai. Tahband aur pajame ko takhne se neecha na kar yeh kibr-o-ghuroor hai aur Allah ko naپسand [na-pasand] hai. Hazrat Luqman ne apne bete ko takbur na karne ki wasiyat ki hai ke aisa na ho ke Allah ke bandon ko haqeer samajh kar tu un se munh mor le aur miskeenon se baat karne se sharmaye. Munh more hue baatein karna bhi ghuroor mein dakhil hai. Bachhein phaar kar lehja badal kar hakimana andaz ke sath ghumanD bhare alfaaz se baat-cheet bhi mamnoo hai. Sa'ar aik beemari hai jo oonton ki gardan mein zahir hoti hai ya sar mein aur is se gardan terhi ho jati hai, pas mutakabbir shakhs ko isi terhe munh wale shakhs se mila diya gaya. Arab umoman takbur ke moqe par sa'ar ka istemal karte hain aur yeh istemal un ke sheron mein bhi mojood hai. Zameen par tan kar akar kar utra kar ghuroor-o-takbur se na chalo yeh chaal Allah ko na-pasand hai. Allah Ta'ala un logon ko na-pasand rakhta hai jo khud-been, mutakabbir, sarkash aur fakhr-o-ghuroor karne wale hon aur ayat mein hai (Wa la tamshi fil ardi marahan, innaka lan takhriqal arda wa lan tablughal jibala toola 37) (17. Al-Isra: 37), yaani akar kar zameen par na chalo na to tum zameen ko phaar sakte ho na paharon ki lambai ko pahunch sakte ho. Is ayat ki tafsir bhi iski jagah guzar chuki hai. Huzoor ﷺ ke samne aik martaba takbur ka zikr kiya gaya to Aap ﷺ ne iski bari mazammat farmai aur farmaya ke aise khud-pasand maghroor logon se Allah ghussa hota hai, is par aik Sahabi ne kaha Ya Rasoolallah ﷺ main jab kapre dhoota hoon aur khoob safed ho jate hain to mujhe bohat achhe lagte hain main un se khush hota hoon. Isi tarah jootey mein tasma bhala lagta hai. Kore ka khoobsurat ghilaf bhala maloom hota hai, Aap ﷺ ne farmaya yeh takbur nahi hai, takbur iska naam hai ke tu haq ko haqeer samjhe aur logon ko zaleel khayal kare. Yeh riwayat aur tareeq se bohat lambi marwi hai aur is mein Hazrat Sabit ke intiqal aur un ki wasiyat ka zikr bhi hai. Aur miyana-rawi ki chaal chal kar na bohat ahista kharaman kharaman na bohat jaldi lambe dak bhar bhar ke. Kalam mein mubaligha na kare, be-faida chekh chilla nahi. Badtareen awaz gadhe ki hai. Jo poori taqat laga kar be-sood chalata hai. Bawajood-ike woh bhi Allah ke samne apni aajizi zahir karta hai. Pas yeh buri misaal de kar samjha diya ke bila-wajah chekhna, dant-dapat karna haram hai. Rasoolallah ﷺ farmate hain buri misalon ke layak hum nahi. Apni de di hui cheez wapas lene wala aisa hai jaise kutta jo qai kar ke chaat leta hai. Nasai mein is ayat ki tafsir mein hai ke Rasoolallah ﷺ ne farmaya jab murgh ki awaz suno to Allah Ta'ala se uska fazal talab karo aur jab gadhe ki awaz suno to Allah Ta'ala se panah talab karo. Is liye ke woh Shaitan ko dekhta hai. Aik riwayat mein hai raat ko. Wallahu A'lam. Yeh wasiyatein Hazrat Luqman Hakim ki nihayat hi nafeh-bakhsh hain. Quran-e-Hakim ne isi liye bayan farmai hain.

Aap se aur bhi bohat hakeemana qaul aur wa'z-o-naseehat ke kalmaat marwi hain. Batour namoonah ke aur dastoor ke hum bhi thore se bayan karte hain. Musnad Ahmad mein ba-zaban-e-Rasoolullah ﷺ Hazrat Luqman Hakeem ka aik qaul yeh bhi marwi hai ke Allah ko jab koi cheez saunp di jaye Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala us ki hifazat karta hai. Aur hadees mein aap ka yeh qaul bhi marwi hai ke tasannu se bach yeh raat ke waqt darauni cheez hai aur din ko mazammat-o-burai wali cheez hai. Aap ne apne bete se yeh bhi farmaya tha ke hikmat se maskeen log baadshah ban jate hain. Aap ka farman hai ke jab kisi majlis mein pahuncho pehle Islami tareeq ke mutabiq salam karo phir majlis ke aik taraf baith jao. Doosre na bole to tum bhi khamosh raho. Agar woh zikrullah karein to tum un mein sab se pehle zyada hissa lene ki koshish karo. Aur agar woh gup shap karein to tum us majlis ko chhod do. Marwi hai ke aap apne bachche ko naseehat karne ke liye jab baithte to rai ki bhari hui aik thaili apne paas rakh lete the aur har har naseehat ke baad aik daana us mein se nikaal lete yahan tak ke thaili khali hogayi to aap ne farmaya bachche agar itni naseehat kisi pahaad ko karta to woh bhi tukde tukde hojata. Chunancha aap ke sahibzade ka bhi yahi haal hua. Rasoolullah ﷺ farmate hain Habshiyon ko rakha karo un mein se teen shakhs ahl-e-jannat ke sardar hain, Luqman Hakeem, Najashi aur Bilal moazzin.
Tawazu aur forutani ka bayan: Hazrat Luqman ne apne bachche ko is ki wasiyat ki thi aur Ibn Abi Dunya ne is masle par aik mustaqil kitab likhi hai. Hum us mein se ahem baatein yahan zikr kar dete hain. Rasoolullah ﷺ farmate hain bohat se paraganda baalon wale, maile kocheele kapdon wale jo kisi bare ghar tak nahi pahunch sakte Allah ke haan itne bare martaba wale hain ke agar woh Allah par koi qasam laga baithein to Allah Ta'ala use bhi poori farma de. Aur hadees mein hai Bara bin Malik aise hi logon mein se hain (R.A). Aik martiba Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne Hazrat Mu'az (R.A) ko qabr-e-Rasool ke paas rote dekh kar daryaft farmaya to jawab mila ke sahib-e-qabr ﷺ se aik hadees main ne suni hai jise yaad karke ro raha hoon. Main ne aap se suna farmate the thori si riyakari bhi shirk hai. Allah Ta'ala unhe dost rakhta hai jo muttaqi hain, jo logon mein chupe chupaye hain, jo kisi ginti mein nahi aate, agar woh kisi majma' mein na hon to koi un ka pursan-e-haal nahi, agar aa jayein to koi aao bhagat nahi lekin un ke dil hidayat ke chiragh hain, woh har aik ghubaar alood andhere se bach kar noor hasil kar lete hain. Huzoor farmate hain yeh maile kocheele kapdon wale jo zaleel gine jate hain Allah ke haan aise muqarrab hain ke agar Allah par qasam kha baithein to Allah poori kar de, go unhe Allah ne duniya nahi di lekin un ki zuban se poori jannat ka sawal bhi nikal jaye to Allah poora kar leta hai.

Aap farmate hain ki meri ummat mein aise log bhi hain ki agar tum mein se kisi ke darwaze par aakar woh log ek dinar ek dirham balki ek fulus bhi mangein toh tum na do lekin Allah ke han woh aise pyare hain ki agar Allah se jannat ki jannat mangein toh Parwardigar de de haan duniya na toh unhein deta hai na rokta hai is liye ki yeh koi qabil-e-qadr cheez nahin. Yeh maile kachhile do chadoron mein rehte hain agar kisi mauqe par qasam kha baithein toh jo qasam unhon ne khai ho Allah puri karta hai. Huzoor farmate hain ki jannat ke badshah log hain jo paraganda aur bikhre hue balon wale hain ghubar alud aur gard se atte hue woh amiron ke ghar jana chahein toh unhein ijazat nahin milti agar kisi bare gharane mein nikah ki mang kar dalein toh wahan ki beti nahin milti. In maskinon se insaf ke burtao nahin barte jate. Inki hajatein aur inki umangein aur muradein puri hone se pehle hi khud hi faut ho jati hain aur arzuwein dil ke dil mein hi reh jati hain unhein qiyamat ke din is qadr noor milega ki agar woh taqseem kiya jaye toh tamam duniya ke liye kafi ho jayega. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mubarak ke sheron mein hai ki bahut se woh log jo duniya mein haqir-o-zalil samjhe jate hain kal qiyamat ke din takht-o-taraj wale mulk-o-manal wale izzat-o-jalal wale bane hue honge. Baghat mein nehron mein nematon mein rahatan mein mashghool honge. Rasool Kareem ﷺ farmate hain ki Janab-e-Bari ka irshad hai sabse zyada mera pasandida wali woh hai jo momin ho kam maal wala kam ayal wala ghazi ibadat-o-itaat guzar poshida-o-alania moti ho logon mein uski izzat aur uska waqar na ho uski janib ungliyan uthti hon aur woh is par sabir ho phir Huzoor ﷺ ne apne hath jhad kar farmaya uski maut jaldi aa jati hai uski miras bahut kam hoti hai uski rone waliyan thodi hoti hain. Farmate hain Allah ke sabse zyada mahbub bande ghurba hain jo apne deen ko liye phirte hain jahan deen ke kamzor hone ka khatra hota hai wahan se nikal khade hote hain yeh qiyamat ke din Hazrat Isa Alaihis Salam ke sath jama honge. Hazrat Fuzail bin Ayyaz ka qaul hai ki mujhe yeh baat maloom hui hai ki Allah Ta'ala qiyamat ke din apne bande se farmayega kya main ne tujh par inaam-o-ikram nahin farmaya ? Kya main ne tujhe diya nahin ? Kya main ne tera jism nahin dhanpa ? Kya main ne tumhein yeh nahin diya ? Kya woh nahin diya ? Kya logon mein tujhe izzat nahin di thi ? Waghaira toh jahan tak hoske in sawalon ke jawab dene ka mauqa kam mile acha hai. Logon ki tareefon se kya fayda aur mazammat karein toh kya nuqsan hoga. Hamare nazdeek toh woh shakhs zyada acha hai jise log bura kehte hon aur woh Allah ke nazdeek acha ho. Ibn Muhiriz toh dua karte the ki Allah meri shohrat na ho.

Khalil bin Ahmad apni dua mein kehte thay Allah mujhe apni nigahon mein tu bulandi ata farma aur khud meri nazar mein mujhe bohat haqeer karde aur logon ki nigahon mein mujhe darmiyana darja ka rakh phir shohrat ka baab baandh kar Imam sahib is hadith ko laaye hain insan ko yehi burai kafi hai ke log is ki deendari ya duniya dari ki shohrat dene lagein aur is ki taraf ungliyan uthne lagein isharay hone lagein. Pas isi mein akar bohat se log halak hojate hain magar jinhein Allah bacha le. Suno Allah Ta'ala tumhari soortoon ko nahi dekhta balki woh tumhare dilon aur amaalon ko dekhta hai. Hazrat Hasan se bhi yehi riwayat mursalan marwi hai jab aap ne yeh riwayat bayan ki to kisi ne kaha aap ki taraf bhi ungliyan uthti hain. Aap ne farmaya samjhe nahi murad ungliyan uthne se deeni bid'at ya duniyawi fisq-o-fujoor hai. Hazrat Ali R.A ka farman hai ke shohrat hasil karna na chaho. Apne tayin ooncha na karo ke logon mein tazkare hone lagein ilm hasil karo lekin chupao chup raho taake salamat raho nekon ko khush rakho badkaron se tasarruf rakho. Hazrat Ibrahim bin Adham farmate hain ke shohrat ka chahne wala Allah ka wali nahi hota. Hazrat Ayyub ka farman hai jise Allah dost bana leta hai woh to logon se apna darja chupata hai. Muhammad bin Ala farmate hain Allah ke dost log apne tayin zahir nahi karte. Samak bin Salma ka qool hai aam logon ke mel jol se aur ahbab ki ziyadati se parhez karo. Hazrat Aban bin Usman farmate hain agar deen ko salim rakhna chahte ho to logon se kam jaan pehchan rakho. Hazrat Abul Aliyah ka qaida tha jab dekhte ke unki majlis mein teen se ziyada log jama hogaye to unhein chhor kar khud chal dete. Hazrat Talha R.A khare thay Hazrat Umar R.A ne kora tana aur farmaya is mein tabe ke liye zillat aur matboo ke liye fitna hai. Hazrat Ibn Masood R.A ke sath jab log chalne lage to aap ne farmaya ke agar tum par mera batin zahir hojaye to tum mein se do bhi mere sath chalna pasand na karein. Hammad bin Zaid kehte hain jab hum kisi majlis ke paas se guzarte aur hamare sath Ayyub hote to salam karte aur woh sakhti se jawab dete. Pas yeh ek nemat thi. Aap lambi qameez pehnte us par logon ne kaha to aap ne jawab diya ke agle zamane mein shohrat ki cheez thi. Lekin yeh shohrat is ko ooncha karne mein hai. Ek martba aap ne apni topiyan masnoon rang ki rangwai aur kuch dinon tak pehn kar utar di aur farmaya maine dekha ke log unhein nahi pehnte. Hazrat Ibrahim Nakhai ka qool hai ke na to aisa libas pehno ke logon ki ungli

Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ka maqoola hai ke aap ne Bani Israel se farmaya mere saamne to darweshon ki poshakh mein aaye halanki tumhare dil bheriyon jaise hain. Suno libas chahe badshahon jaisa pehno magar dil khauf-e-Khuda se naram rakho. 

Achhe akhlaq ka bayan: Huzoor ﷺ sab se behtar akhlaq wale thay. Aap se sawal hua ke konsa momin behtar hai? Farmaya sab se achhe akhlaq wala. Aap ka farman hai ke bawajood kam aamal ke sirf achhe akhlaq ki wajah se insan bare bare darje aur Jannat ke aala manazil hasil kar leta hai. Aur bawajood bohat sari nekiyon ke sirf akhlaq ki burayi ki wajah se Jahannam ke niche ke tabqe mein chala jata hai. Farmate hain achhe akhlaq hi mein dunya akhirat ki bhalai hai. Farmate hain insan apni khush-akhlaqi ke bais raton ko qiyam karne wale aur dinon ko roze rakhne walon ke darjon ko pa leta hai. 

Huzoor ﷺ se sawal hua ke dakhool-e-Jannat ka mojib aam taur se kya hai? Farmaya Allah ka dar aur akhlaq ki achhayi. Pucha gaya aam taur se Jahannam mein konsi cheez le jati hai? Farmaya do surakh-dar cheezein yani munh aur sharmgah. 

Ek martaba chand a'rab ke is sawal par ke insan ko sab se behtar atiya kya mila hai? Farmaya ke husn-e-akhlaq. Farmaya ke neki ki tarazu mein achhe akhlaq se zyada wazni cheez aur koi nahi. Farmate hain tum mein se sab se behtar woh hai jo sab se achhe akhlaq wala hai. Farmate hain jis tarah mujahid ko Allah ki rah mein jihad karne par subh sham ajar milta hai usi tarah achhe akhlaq par bhi Allah sawab ata farmata hai. 

Irshad hai tum mein mujhe sab se zyada mahboob aur sab se zyada qareeb woh hai jo sab se achhe akhlaq wala hai. Mere nazdeek sab se zyada bughz-o-nafrat ke qabil aur mujh se sab se door Jannat mein woh hoga jo bad-khlaq, bad-go, bad-kalam, bad-zaban hoga. 

Farmate hain kamil imandar achhe akhlaq wale hain jo har ek se sulook-o-mohabbat se milen jilen. Irshad hai jis ki paidaish aur akhlaq achhe hain use Allah Ta'ala Jahannam ka luqma nahi banayega. Irshad hai ke do khaslatein momin mein jama nahi ho saktin; bukhl aur bad-akhlaqi. 

Farmate hain bad-akhlaqi se zyada bara koi gunah nahi. Is liye ke bad-akhlaqi se insan ek se ek bare gunah mein mubtila ho jata hai. Huzoor ka irshad hai Allah ke nazdeek bad-akhlaqi se bara koi gunah nahi. Achhe akhlaq se gunah maaf ho jate hain. Bad-akhlaqiyan naik aamalon ko gharat kar deti hain. Jaise shehad ko sirka kharab kar deta hai. 

Huzoor farmate hain ke ghulam khareedne se ghulam nahi barhte albatta khush-akhlaqi se log grovida ho jate hain. Imam Muhammad bin Sireen ka qaul hai ke achha khulaq deen ki madad hai.

Takabbur ki muzammat ka bayan: Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain woh Jannat mein na jayega jis ke dil mein rai ke dane ke barabar takabbur ho. Aur woh jahannami nahi jis ke dil mein rai ke barabar iman ho. Farmate hain ke jis ke dil mein ek zarre ke barabar takabbur hai woh andhe munh Jahannam mein jayenge. Irshad hai ke insan apne ghuroor aur khud-pasandi mein barhte barhte Allah ke haan jabbaron mein likh diya jata hai.

Phir sarkashon ke azab mein phans jata hai. Imam Malik bin Dinar Rahimahullah farmate hain ek din Hazrat Sulaiman bin Daud A.S apne takht par baithe the aap ke darbar mein us waqt do lakh insan the aur do lakh jin the aap ko aasman tak pohanchaya gaya yahan tak ke farishton ki tasbih ki aawaz kaan mein aane lagi. Aur phir zameen tak laya gaya yahan tak ke samandar ke pani se aap ke qadam bheeg gaye. Phir hatif-e-ghaib ne neda di ke agar is ke dil mein ek dane ke barabar bhi takabbur hota to jitna ooncha gaya tha us se zyada neeche dhansa diya jata. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique R.A ne apne khutbe mein insan ki ibtidai paidaish ka bayan karte hue farmaya ke yeh do shakhson ki peshab-gah se nikalta hai. Is tarah ise bayan farmaya ke sunne wale karahat karne lage. Imam Sha'abi ka qaul hai jis ne do shakhson ko qatal kar diya woh bada hi sarkash aur jabbar hai phir aap ne yeh aayat padhi (Atureedu an taqtulani kama qatalta nafsan bil-ams 19) (28. Al-Qasas: 19) Kya tu mujhe qatal karna chahta hai? Jaise ke tu ne kal ek shakhs ko qatal kiya hai. Tera irada to duniya mein sarkash aur jabbar ban kar rehne ka maloom hota hai. Hazrat Hasan ka maqula hai woh insan jo har din mein do martaba apna pakhana apne hath se dhota hai woh kis bina par takabbur karta hai aur is ka wasf apne mein paida karna chahta hai jis ne aasmaanon ko paida kiya hai aur apne qabze mein rakha hai. Zahhak bin Sufyan se duniya ki misaal us cheez se bhi marwi hai jo insan se nikalti hai. Imam Muhammad bin Husain bin Ali farmate hain jis dil mein jitna takabbur aur ghamand hota hai utni hi aql uski kam ho jati hai. Yunus bin Ubaid farmate hain ke sajda karne ke sath takabbur aur tauhid ke sath nifaq nahi hua karta. Bani Umayyah maar maar kar apni aulad ko akda kar chalna sikhate the. Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz ko aap ki khilafat se pehle ek martaba uthlati hui chaal chalte hue dekh kar Hazrat Tawus ne unke pehlu mein ek thonka mara aur farmaya yeh chaal uski hai jis ke pait mein pakhana bhara hua hai? Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz bahut sharminda hue aur kehne lage maaf farmaiye hamein maar maar kar is chaal ki aadat dalwai gayi hai. Fakr-o-ghamand ki mazammat ka bayan: Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain jo shakhs fakr-o-ghuroor se apna kapda neeche latka kar ghaseetega Allah Ta'ala qayamat ke din uski taraf rehmat se na dekhega. Farmate hain iski taraf Allah qayamat ke din nazar na daalega jo apna tahband latkaye. Ek shakhs do umda chadrein odhe dil mein ghuroor liye akadta hua ja raha tha ke Allah Ta'ala ne ise zameen mein dhansa diya qayamat tak woh dhanta hua chala jayega.

Qiyamat ke din aala akhlaq kaam aaye ga. Hazrat Luqman ki yeh aur Wasiyatein hain aur chunke yeh sab hikmaton se pur hain, Quran unhein bayaan farma raha hai taake log un par amal karein. Farmate hain ke burai khata zulm hai chahe rai ke daane ke barabar bhi ho, phir woh khana hi posheeda aur dhaka chupa kyun na ho, Qiyamat ke din Allah use pesh karega, mizan mein sab ko rakha jayega aur badla diya jayega, naik kaam par jaza aur bad par saza, jaise farman hai: Ayat (WANADA’UL MAWAZINAL QISHTA LILYOUMIL QIYAMATI FALA TUZLAMU NAFSUN SHAIAN) (21. Al-Anbiya: 47), yaani Qiyamat ke din adl ke tarazu rakh kar har ek ko badla denge, koi zulm na kiya jayega. Aur aikat mein hai zarre barabar neki aur zarre barabar burai har ek dekh lega, khwa woh neki ya badi kisi makan mein, mahal mein, qila mein, pathar ke sorakh mein, asmanon ke konon mein, zameen ki teh mein ho, kahin bhi ho Allah Ta'ala se makhfi nahi, woh use la kar pesh karega, woh bare bareek ilm wala hai. Chhoti se chhoti cheez bhi us par zahir hai, andheri raat mein cheenti jo chal rahi ho us ke paon ki aahat ka bhi woh ilm rakhta hai. Baaz ne yeh bhi jaiz rakha hai ke inna mein zameer-e-shaan ki aur qissa ki hai aur is bina par unhon ne misqal ki laam ka pesh parhna bhi jaiz rakha hai lekin pehli baat hi zyada achhi hai. Baaz kehte hain ke sakhra se murad woh pathar hai jo satween asman aur zameen ke niche hain, is ki baaz sanadein bhi Bani Israel se hain agar sahih sabit ho jayein, baaz Sahaba se marwi to hai Wallahu A'lam. Bohat mumkin hai ke yeh bhi Bani Israel se manqool ho lekin un ki kitabon ki kisi baat ko hum na sachi maan sakein na jhutla sakein. Ba-zahir yeh maloom hota hai ke ba-qadar rai ke daane ke koi amal haqeer ho aur aisa posheeda ho ke kisi pathar ke andar ho, jaise Musnad Ahmad ki hadith mein hai Rasoolullah ﷺ farmate hain: Agar tum mein se koi shakhs koi amal kare kisi be-sorakh ke pathar ke andar jis ka na koi darwaza ho na khirki ho na sorakh ho, taham Allah Ta'ala use logon par zahir kar dega khwa kuch hi amal ho naik ho ya bad. Phir farmate hain: Bete namaz ka khayal rakhna, is ke faraiz, is ke wajibat, arkaan, auqaat waghera ki poori hifazat karna, apni taqat ke mutabiq poori koshish karna, sath Allah ki baton ki tabligh apnon parayon mein karte rehna, bhali baatein karne aur buri baton se bachne ke liye har ek se kehna aur chunke neki ka hukam yani badi se rokna jo عموماً logon ko karwi lagti hai aur haq-go shakhs se log dushmani rakhte hain is liye sath hi farmaya ke logon se jo eza aur museebat pahuche us par sabr karna, dar-haqeeqat Allah ki raah mein nangi shamshir rehna aur haq par museebatein jhelte hue past himmat na hona yeh bara bhaari aur jawanmardi ka kaam hai. Phir farmate hain: Apna munh logon se na mor, unhein haqeer samajh kar ya apne taiy bara samajh kar logon se takabbur na kar, balke narmi barat, khush-khulqi se pesh aa, khanda-peshani se baat kar.

Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai ke kisi Musalman bhai se tu kushada peshani se hans mukh ho kar mile yeh bhi teri bari neki hai. Tahband aur pajame ko takhne se neecha na kar yeh kibr-o-ghuroor hai aur Allah ko naپسand [na-pasand] hai. Hazrat Luqman ne apne bete ko takbur na karne ki wasiyat ki hai ke aisa na ho ke Allah ke bandon ko haqeer samajh kar tu un se munh mor le aur miskeenon se baat karne se sharmaye. Munh more hue baatein karna bhi ghuroor mein dakhil hai. Bachhein phaar kar lehja badal kar hakimana andaz ke sath ghumanD bhare alfaaz se baat-cheet bhi mamnoo hai. Sa'ar aik beemari hai jo oonton ki gardan mein zahir hoti hai ya sar mein aur is se gardan terhi ho jati hai, pas mutakabbir shakhs ko isi terhe munh wale shakhs se mila diya gaya. Arab umoman takbur ke moqe par sa'ar ka istemal karte hain aur yeh istemal un ke sheron mein bhi mojood hai. Zameen par tan kar akar kar utra kar ghuroor-o-takbur se na chalo yeh chaal Allah ko na-pasand hai. Allah Ta'ala un logon ko na-pasand rakhta hai jo khud-been, mutakabbir, sarkash aur fakhr-o-ghuroor karne wale hon aur ayat mein hai (Wa la tamshi fil ardi marahan, innaka lan takhriqal arda wa lan tablughal jibala toola 37) (17. Al-Isra: 37), yaani akar kar zameen par na chalo na to tum zameen ko phaar sakte ho na paharon ki lambai ko pahunch sakte ho. Is ayat ki tafsir bhi iski jagah guzar chuki hai. Huzoor ﷺ ke samne aik martaba takbur ka zikr kiya gaya to Aap ﷺ ne iski bari mazammat farmai aur farmaya ke aise khud-pasand maghroor logon se Allah ghussa hota hai, is par aik Sahabi ne kaha Ya Rasoolallah ﷺ main jab kapre dhoota hoon aur khoob safed ho jate hain to mujhe bohat achhe lagte hain main un se khush hota hoon. Isi tarah jootey mein tasma bhala lagta hai. Kore ka khoobsurat ghilaf bhala maloom hota hai, Aap ﷺ ne farmaya yeh takbur nahi hai, takbur iska naam hai ke tu haq ko haqeer samjhe aur logon ko zaleel khayal kare. Yeh riwayat aur tareeq se bohat lambi marwi hai aur is mein Hazrat Sabit ke intiqal aur un ki wasiyat ka zikr bhi hai. Aur miyana-rawi ki chaal chal kar na bohat ahista kharaman kharaman na bohat jaldi lambe dak bhar bhar ke. Kalam mein mubaligha na kare, be-faida chekh chilla nahi. Badtareen awaz gadhe ki hai. Jo poori taqat laga kar be-sood chalata hai. Bawajood-ike woh bhi Allah ke samne apni aajizi zahir karta hai. Pas yeh buri misaal de kar samjha diya ke bila-wajah chekhna, dant-dapat karna haram hai. Rasoolallah ﷺ farmate hain buri misalon ke layak hum nahi. Apni de di hui cheez wapas lene wala aisa hai jaise kutta jo qai kar ke chaat leta hai. Nasai mein is ayat ki tafsir mein hai ke Rasoolallah ﷺ ne farmaya jab murgh ki awaz suno to Allah Ta'ala se uska fazal talab karo aur jab gadhe ki awaz suno to Allah Ta'ala se panah talab karo. Is liye ke woh Shaitan ko dekhta hai. Aik riwayat mein hai raat ko. Wallahu A'lam. Yeh wasiyatein Hazrat Luqman Hakim ki nihayat hi nafeh-bakhsh hain. Quran-e-Hakim ne isi liye bayan farmai hain.

Aap se aur bhi bohat hakeemana qaul aur wa'z-o-naseehat ke kalmaat marwi hain. Batour namoonah ke aur dastoor ke hum bhi thore se bayan karte hain. Musnad Ahmad mein ba-zaban-e-Rasoolullah ﷺ Hazrat Luqman Hakeem ka aik qaul yeh bhi marwi hai ke Allah ko jab koi cheez saunp di jaye Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala us ki hifazat karta hai. Aur hadees mein aap ka yeh qaul bhi marwi hai ke tasannu se bach yeh raat ke waqt darauni cheez hai aur din ko mazammat-o-burai wali cheez hai. Aap ne apne bete se yeh bhi farmaya tha ke hikmat se maskeen log baadshah ban jate hain. Aap ka farman hai ke jab kisi majlis mein pahuncho pehle Islami tareeq ke mutabiq salam karo phir majlis ke aik taraf baith jao. Doosre na bole to tum bhi khamosh raho. Agar woh zikrullah karein to tum un mein sab se pehle zyada hissa lene ki koshish karo. Aur agar woh gup shap karein to tum us majlis ko chhod do. Marwi hai ke aap apne bachche ko naseehat karne ke liye jab baithte to rai ki bhari hui aik thaili apne paas rakh lete the aur har har naseehat ke baad aik daana us mein se nikaal lete yahan tak ke thaili khali hogayi to aap ne farmaya bachche agar itni naseehat kisi pahaad ko karta to woh bhi tukde tukde hojata. Chunancha aap ke sahibzade ka bhi yahi haal hua. Rasoolullah ﷺ farmate hain Habshiyon ko rakha karo un mein se teen shakhs ahl-e-jannat ke sardar hain, Luqman Hakeem, Najashi aur Bilal moazzin.
Tawazu aur forutani ka bayan: Hazrat Luqman ne apne bachche ko is ki wasiyat ki thi aur Ibn Abi Dunya ne is masle par aik mustaqil kitab likhi hai. Hum us mein se ahem baatein yahan zikr kar dete hain. Rasoolullah ﷺ farmate hain bohat se paraganda baalon wale, maile kocheele kapdon wale jo kisi bare ghar tak nahi pahunch sakte Allah ke haan itne bare martaba wale hain ke agar woh Allah par koi qasam laga baithein to Allah Ta'ala use bhi poori farma de. Aur hadees mein hai Bara bin Malik aise hi logon mein se hain (R.A). Aik martiba Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne Hazrat Mu'az (R.A) ko qabr-e-Rasool ke paas rote dekh kar daryaft farmaya to jawab mila ke sahib-e-qabr ﷺ se aik hadees main ne suni hai jise yaad karke ro raha hoon. Main ne aap se suna farmate the thori si riyakari bhi shirk hai. Allah Ta'ala unhe dost rakhta hai jo muttaqi hain, jo logon mein chupe chupaye hain, jo kisi ginti mein nahi aate, agar woh kisi majma' mein na hon to koi un ka pursan-e-haal nahi, agar aa jayein to koi aao bhagat nahi lekin un ke dil hidayat ke chiragh hain, woh har aik ghubaar alood andhere se bach kar noor hasil kar lete hain. Huzoor farmate hain yeh maile kocheele kapdon wale jo zaleel gine jate hain Allah ke haan aise muqarrab hain ke agar Allah par qasam kha baithein to Allah poori kar de, go unhe Allah ne duniya nahi di lekin un ki zuban se poori jannat ka sawal bhi nikal jaye to Allah poora kar leta hai.

Aap farmate hain ki meri ummat mein aise log bhi hain ki agar tum mein se kisi ke darwaze par aakar woh log ek dinar ek dirham balki ek fulus bhi mangein toh tum na do lekin Allah ke han woh aise pyare hain ki agar Allah se jannat ki jannat mangein toh Parwardigar de de haan duniya na toh unhein deta hai na rokta hai is liye ki yeh koi qabil-e-qadr cheez nahin. Yeh maile kachhile do chadoron mein rehte hain agar kisi mauqe par qasam kha baithein toh jo qasam unhon ne khai ho Allah puri karta hai. Huzoor farmate hain ki jannat ke badshah log hain jo paraganda aur bikhre hue balon wale hain ghubar alud aur gard se atte hue woh amiron ke ghar jana chahein toh unhein ijazat nahin milti agar kisi bare gharane mein nikah ki mang kar dalein toh wahan ki beti nahin milti. In maskinon se insaf ke burtao nahin barte jate. Inki hajatein aur inki umangein aur muradein puri hone se pehle hi khud hi faut ho jati hain aur arzuwein dil ke dil mein hi reh jati hain unhein qiyamat ke din is qadr noor milega ki agar woh taqseem kiya jaye toh tamam duniya ke liye kafi ho jayega. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mubarak ke sheron mein hai ki bahut se woh log jo duniya mein haqir-o-zalil samjhe jate hain kal qiyamat ke din takht-o-taraj wale mulk-o-manal wale izzat-o-jalal wale bane hue honge. Baghat mein nehron mein nematon mein rahatan mein mashghool honge. Rasool Kareem ﷺ farmate hain ki Janab-e-Bari ka irshad hai sabse zyada mera pasandida wali woh hai jo momin ho kam maal wala kam ayal wala ghazi ibadat-o-itaat guzar poshida-o-alania moti ho logon mein uski izzat aur uska waqar na ho uski janib ungliyan uthti hon aur woh is par sabir ho phir Huzoor ﷺ ne apne hath jhad kar farmaya uski maut jaldi aa jati hai uski miras bahut kam hoti hai uski rone waliyan thodi hoti hain. Farmate hain Allah ke sabse zyada mahbub bande ghurba hain jo apne deen ko liye phirte hain jahan deen ke kamzor hone ka khatra hota hai wahan se nikal khade hote hain yeh qiyamat ke din Hazrat Isa Alaihis Salam ke sath jama honge. Hazrat Fuzail bin Ayyaz ka qaul hai ki mujhe yeh baat maloom hui hai ki Allah Ta'ala qiyamat ke din apne bande se farmayega kya main ne tujh par inaam-o-ikram nahin farmaya ? Kya main ne tujhe diya nahin ? Kya main ne tera jism nahin dhanpa ? Kya main ne tumhein yeh nahin diya ? Kya woh nahin diya ? Kya logon mein tujhe izzat nahin di thi ? Waghaira toh jahan tak hoske in sawalon ke jawab dene ka mauqa kam mile acha hai. Logon ki tareefon se kya fayda aur mazammat karein toh kya nuqsan hoga. Hamare nazdeek toh woh shakhs zyada acha hai jise log bura kehte hon aur woh Allah ke nazdeek acha ho. Ibn Muhiriz toh dua karte the ki Allah meri shohrat na ho.

Khalil bin Ahmad apni dua mein kehte thay Allah mujhe apni nigahon mein tu bulandi ata farma aur khud meri nazar mein mujhe bohat haqeer karde aur logon ki nigahon mein mujhe darmiyana darja ka rakh phir shohrat ka baab baandh kar Imam sahib is hadith ko laaye hain insan ko yehi burai kafi hai ke log is ki deendari ya duniya dari ki shohrat dene lagein aur is ki taraf ungliyan uthne lagein isharay hone lagein. Pas isi mein akar bohat se log halak hojate hain magar jinhein Allah bacha le. Suno Allah Ta'ala tumhari soortoon ko nahi dekhta balki woh tumhare dilon aur amaalon ko dekhta hai. Hazrat Hasan se bhi yehi riwayat mursalan marwi hai jab aap ne yeh riwayat bayan ki to kisi ne kaha aap ki taraf bhi ungliyan uthti hain. Aap ne farmaya samjhe nahi murad ungliyan uthne se deeni bid'at ya duniyawi fisq-o-fujoor hai. Hazrat Ali R.A ka farman hai ke shohrat hasil karna na chaho. Apne tayin ooncha na karo ke logon mein tazkare hone lagein ilm hasil karo lekin chupao chup raho taake salamat raho nekon ko khush rakho badkaron se tasarruf rakho. Hazrat Ibrahim bin Adham farmate hain ke shohrat ka chahne wala Allah ka wali nahi hota. Hazrat Ayyub ka farman hai jise Allah dost bana leta hai woh to logon se apna darja chupata hai. Muhammad bin Ala farmate hain Allah ke dost log apne tayin zahir nahi karte. Samak bin Salma ka qool hai aam logon ke mel jol se aur ahbab ki ziyadati se parhez karo. Hazrat Aban bin Usman farmate hain agar deen ko salim rakhna chahte ho to logon se kam jaan pehchan rakho. Hazrat Abul Aliyah ka qaida tha jab dekhte ke unki majlis mein teen se ziyada log jama hogaye to unhein chhor kar khud chal dete. Hazrat Talha R.A khare thay Hazrat Umar R.A ne kora tana aur farmaya is mein tabe ke liye zillat aur matboo ke liye fitna hai. Hazrat Ibn Masood R.A ke sath jab log chalne lage to aap ne farmaya ke agar tum par mera batin zahir hojaye to tum mein se do bhi mere sath chalna pasand na karein. Hammad bin Zaid kehte hain jab hum kisi majlis ke paas se guzarte aur hamare sath Ayyub hote to salam karte aur woh sakhti se jawab dete. Pas yeh ek nemat thi. Aap lambi qameez pehnte us par logon ne kaha to aap ne jawab diya ke agle zamane mein shohrat ki cheez thi. Lekin yeh shohrat is ko ooncha karne mein hai. Ek martba aap ne apni topiyan masnoon rang ki rangwai aur kuch dinon tak pehn kar utar di aur farmaya maine dekha ke log unhein nahi pehnte. Hazrat Ibrahim Nakhai ka qool hai ke na to aisa libas pehno ke logon ki ungli

Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ka maqoola hai ke aap ne Bani Israel se farmaya mere saamne to darweshon ki poshakh mein aaye halanki tumhare dil bheriyon jaise hain. Suno libas chahe badshahon jaisa pehno magar dil khauf-e-Khuda se naram rakho. 

Achhe akhlaq ka bayan: Huzoor ﷺ sab se behtar akhlaq wale thay. Aap se sawal hua ke konsa momin behtar hai? Farmaya sab se achhe akhlaq wala. Aap ka farman hai ke bawajood kam aamal ke sirf achhe akhlaq ki wajah se insan bare bare darje aur Jannat ke aala manazil hasil kar leta hai. Aur bawajood bohat sari nekiyon ke sirf akhlaq ki burayi ki wajah se Jahannam ke niche ke tabqe mein chala jata hai. Farmate hain achhe akhlaq hi mein dunya akhirat ki bhalai hai. Farmate hain insan apni khush-akhlaqi ke bais raton ko qiyam karne wale aur dinon ko roze rakhne walon ke darjon ko pa leta hai. 

Huzoor ﷺ se sawal hua ke dakhool-e-Jannat ka mojib aam taur se kya hai? Farmaya Allah ka dar aur akhlaq ki achhayi. Pucha gaya aam taur se Jahannam mein konsi cheez le jati hai? Farmaya do surakh-dar cheezein yani munh aur sharmgah. 

Ek martaba chand a'rab ke is sawal par ke insan ko sab se behtar atiya kya mila hai? Farmaya ke husn-e-akhlaq. Farmaya ke neki ki tarazu mein achhe akhlaq se zyada wazni cheez aur koi nahi. Farmate hain tum mein se sab se behtar woh hai jo sab se achhe akhlaq wala hai. Farmate hain jis tarah mujahid ko Allah ki rah mein jihad karne par subh sham ajar milta hai usi tarah achhe akhlaq par bhi Allah sawab ata farmata hai. 

Irshad hai tum mein mujhe sab se zyada mahboob aur sab se zyada qareeb woh hai jo sab se achhe akhlaq wala hai. Mere nazdeek sab se zyada bughz-o-nafrat ke qabil aur mujh se sab se door Jannat mein woh hoga jo bad-khlaq, bad-go, bad-kalam, bad-zaban hoga. 

Farmate hain kamil imandar achhe akhlaq wale hain jo har ek se sulook-o-mohabbat se milen jilen. Irshad hai jis ki paidaish aur akhlaq achhe hain use Allah Ta'ala Jahannam ka luqma nahi banayega. Irshad hai ke do khaslatein momin mein jama nahi ho saktin; bukhl aur bad-akhlaqi. 

Farmate hain bad-akhlaqi se zyada bara koi gunah nahi. Is liye ke bad-akhlaqi se insan ek se ek bare gunah mein mubtila ho jata hai. Huzoor ka irshad hai Allah ke nazdeek bad-akhlaqi se bara koi gunah nahi. Achhe akhlaq se gunah maaf ho jate hain. Bad-akhlaqiyan naik aamalon ko gharat kar deti hain. Jaise shehad ko sirka kharab kar deta hai. 

Huzoor farmate hain ke ghulam khareedne se ghulam nahi barhte albatta khush-akhlaqi se log grovida ho jate hain. Imam Muhammad bin Sireen ka qaul hai ke achha khulaq deen ki madad hai.

Takabbur ki muzammat ka bayan: Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain woh Jannat mein na jayega jis ke dil mein rai ke dane ke barabar takabbur ho. Aur woh jahannami nahi jis ke dil mein rai ke barabar iman ho. Farmate hain ke jis ke dil mein ek zarre ke barabar takabbur hai woh andhe munh Jahannam mein jayenge. Irshad hai ke insan apne ghuroor aur khud-pasandi mein barhte barhte Allah ke haan jabbaron mein likh diya jata hai.

Phir sarkashon ke azab mein phans jata hai. Imam Malik bin Dinar Rahimahullah farmate hain ek din Hazrat Sulaiman bin Daud A.S apne takht par baithe the aap ke darbar mein us waqt do lakh insan the aur do lakh jin the aap ko aasman tak pohanchaya gaya yahan tak ke farishton ki tasbih ki aawaz kaan mein aane lagi. Aur phir zameen tak laya gaya yahan tak ke samandar ke pani se aap ke qadam bheeg gaye. Phir hatif-e-ghaib ne neda di ke agar is ke dil mein ek dane ke barabar bhi takabbur hota to jitna ooncha gaya tha us se zyada neeche dhansa diya jata. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique R.A ne apne khutbe mein insan ki ibtidai paidaish ka bayan karte hue farmaya ke yeh do shakhson ki peshab-gah se nikalta hai. Is tarah ise bayan farmaya ke sunne wale karahat karne lage. Imam Sha'abi ka qaul hai jis ne do shakhson ko qatal kar diya woh bada hi sarkash aur jabbar hai phir aap ne yeh aayat padhi (Atureedu an taqtulani kama qatalta nafsan bil-ams 19) (28. Al-Qasas: 19) Kya tu mujhe qatal karna chahta hai? Jaise ke tu ne kal ek shakhs ko qatal kiya hai. Tera irada to duniya mein sarkash aur jabbar ban kar rehne ka maloom hota hai. Hazrat Hasan ka maqula hai woh insan jo har din mein do martaba apna pakhana apne hath se dhota hai woh kis bina par takabbur karta hai aur is ka wasf apne mein paida karna chahta hai jis ne aasmaanon ko paida kiya hai aur apne qabze mein rakha hai. Zahhak bin Sufyan se duniya ki misaal us cheez se bhi marwi hai jo insan se nikalti hai. Imam Muhammad bin Husain bin Ali farmate hain jis dil mein jitna takabbur aur ghamand hota hai utni hi aql uski kam ho jati hai. Yunus bin Ubaid farmate hain ke sajda karne ke sath takabbur aur tauhid ke sath nifaq nahi hua karta. Bani Umayyah maar maar kar apni aulad ko akda kar chalna sikhate the. Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz ko aap ki khilafat se pehle ek martaba uthlati hui chaal chalte hue dekh kar Hazrat Tawus ne unke pehlu mein ek thonka mara aur farmaya yeh chaal uski hai jis ke pait mein pakhana bhara hua hai? Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz bahut sharminda hue aur kehne lage maaf farmaiye hamein maar maar kar is chaal ki aadat dalwai gayi hai. Fakr-o-ghamand ki mazammat ka bayan: Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain jo shakhs fakr-o-ghuroor se apna kapda neeche latka kar ghaseetega Allah Ta'ala qayamat ke din uski taraf rehmat se na dekhega. Farmate hain iski taraf Allah qayamat ke din nazar na daalega jo apna tahband latkaye. Ek shakhs do umda chadrein odhe dil mein ghuroor liye akadta hua ja raha tha ke Allah Ta'ala ne ise zameen mein dhansa diya qayamat tak woh dhanta hua chala jayega.

In'am-o-Ikram ki baarish Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala apni nematon ka izhar farma raha hai ke dekho asman ke sitare tumhare liye kaam mein mashghool hain chamak chamak kar tumhein roshni pohncha rahe hain badal barish olay khunki sab tumhare nafa ki cheezein hain khud asman tumhare liye mehfooz aur mazboot chhat hai. Zameen ki nahrein chashmey darya samandar darakht kheti phal yeh sab nematein bhi usi ne de rakhi hain. Phir in zahiri beshumar nematon ke ilawa batini beshumar nematein bhi usi ne tumhein de rakhi hain masalan rasoolon ka bhejna kitabon ka nazil farmana shak-o-shubah waghera dilon se door karna waghera. Itni badi aur itni sari nematein jis ne de rakhi hain haq yeh tha ke us ki zaat par sab ke sab iman late lekin afsos ke bohat

In'am-o-Ikram ki baarish Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala apni nematon ka izhar farma raha hai ke dekho asman ke sitare tumhare liye kaam mein mashghool hain chamak chamak kar tumhein roshni pohncha rahe hain badal barish olay khunki sab tumhare nafa ki cheezein hain khud asman tumhare liye mehfooz aur mazboot chhat hai. Zameen ki nahrein chashmey darya samandar darakht kheti phal yeh sab nematein bhi usi ne de rakhi hain. Phir in zahiri beshumar nematon ke ilawa batini beshumar nematein bhi usi ne tumhein de rakhi hain masalan rasoolon ka bhejna kitabon ka nazil farmana shak-o-shubah waghera dilon se door karna waghera. Itni badi aur itni sari nematein jis ne de rakhi hain haq yeh tha ke us ki zaat par sab ke sab iman late lekin afsos ke bohat

Mazboot dastavez farmata hai ke jo apne amal mein ikhlaas paida kare, jo Allah ka sacha farmanbardar ban jaye, jo shariat ka tabedar hojaye, Allah ke hukmon par amal kare, Allah ke mana karda kaamon se baaz ajaye, usne mazboot dastavez hasil karli, goya Allah ka wada le liya ke azabon mein woh najaat yafta hai. Kaamon ka anjam Allah ke hath hai. Ae pyare paighambar (ﷺ) kafiron ke kufr se ap ghamgeen na hon. Allah ki tehreer yunhi jari hochuki hai, sab ka lotna Allah ki taraf hai. Us waqt aamal ke badle milenge, us Allah par koi baat poshida nahi. Duniya mein maze karlein, phir to un azabon ko bebasi se bardasht karna padega jo bohat sakht aur nihayat ghabrahat wale hain, jaise aur ayat mein hai (Qul innallazeena yaftaroona 'alal-labil-kaziba la yuflihoon) (Surah Yunus: 69). Allah par jhoot iftara karne wale falah se mehroom reh jate hain. Duniya ka faida to khair alag cheez hai lekin hamare han (maut ke baad) ane ke baad to apne kufr ki sakht saza bhugtani padegi.

Syed-ul-Bashar Khatam-ul-Anbiya ﷺ farmaya karte thay: (La ahsi thana'an 'alayka kama athnaita 'ala nafsika) Aaye Allah! Yeh na samjha jaye ke saat samandar hon toh phir Allah ke pure kalmaat likhne ke liye kafi ho jayen. Nahi, yeh ginti toh ziyadati dikhane ke liye hai. Aur yeh bhi na samjha jaye ke saat samandar mojood hain aur woh alam ko ghere hue hain, albatta Bani Israel ki in saat samandar ki baat aisi riwayatein hain lekin na toh unhein sach kaha ja sakta hai aur na hi jhutlaya ja sakta hai.
