(Qul lau kana al-bahru midadan li-kalimati rabbi la nafida al-bahru qabla an tanfada kalimatu rabbi wa lau ji'na bi-mithlihi madada) (18. Al-Kahf: 109) 
Yaani agar samandar siyahi ban jayen aur Rab ke kalmaat ka likhna shuru ho toh kalmaat-e-Allah ke khatam hone se pehle hi samandar khatam ho jayen agarche aisa hi aur samandar is ki madad mein layen. Allah Ta'ala ke rubaro kya hoga? Allah Ta'ala logon ko Qiyamat ke din se dara raha hai aur apne taqwa ka hukm farma raha hai. Irshad hai: Is din baap apne bachche ko ya bachcha apne baap ko kuch kaam na aayega, ek dusre ka fidiya na hosakega. Tum duniya par itmad karne walo! Aakhirat ko faramosh na kar jao, Shaitan ke fareib mein na aajao, woh toh sirf parde ki aar mein shikaar khelna jaanta hai.

Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai, Hazrat Uzair (Alaihis Salam) ne jab apni kaum ki takleef mulahiza ki aur gham-o-ranj bahut barh gaya, neend uchaat hogayi toh apne Rabb ki taraf jhuke. Farmate hain: Main ne nihayat tazarru-o-zari ki, khoob roya, girgiraya, namazein parhin, roze rakhe, duaein mangin. Ek martaba ro ro kar tazarru kar raha tha ke mere samne ek farishta aagaya. Main ne us se pucha: Kya naik log buron ki shafaat karenge? Ya baap beto ke kaam aayenge? 

Us ne farmaya ke Qiyamat ka din jhagron ke faislon ka din hai, is din Allah khud samne hoga, koi baghair us ki ijazat ke lab na hila sakega, kisi ko dusre ke badle na pakda jayega, na baap bete ke badle, na beta baap ke badle, na bhai bhai ke badle, na ghulam aaqa ke badle, na koi kisi ka gham-o-ranj karega, na kisi ki taraf se kisi ko khayal hoga, na kisi par raham karega, na kisi ko kisi se shafaqat-o-mohabbat hogi, na ek dusre ki taraf pakda jayega. Har shakhs nafsi-nafsi mein hoga, har ek apni fikar mein hoga, har ek ko apna rona pada hoga, har ek apna bojh uthaye hue hoga kisi aur ka nahi.

Ghaib ki paanch baatein: Yeh Ghaib ki woh kunjiyaan hain jin ka ilm bajuz Allah Ta'ala ke kisi aur ko nahi. Magar is ke baad ke Allah isey ilm ata farmaye. Qiyamat ke aane ka sahi waqt na koi Nabi-e-Mursal jaane na koi muqarrab farishta, is ka waqt sirf Allah hi jaanta hai, isi tarah baarish kab aur kahan aur kitni barsey gi is ka ilm bhi kisi ko nahi, haan jab farishton ko hukm hota hai jo is par muqarrar hain tab woh jaante hain aur jisey Allah maloom karaye. Isi tarah haamila ke pait mein kya hai? Isey bhi sirf Allah hi jaanta hai ke nar hoga ya mada, larka hoga ya larki, naik hoga ya bad? Isi tarah kisi ko yeh bhi maloom nahi ke kal woh kya karega? Na kisi ko yeh ilm hai ke woh kahan marega? Aur aayat mein hai: (Wa indahu mafatih-ul-ghaibi la ya'lmuha illa huwa - 6:59) Ghaib ki kunjiyaan Allah hi ke paas hain jinhein bajuz us ke aur koi nahi jaanta. Aur hadith mein hai ke Ghaib ki kunjiyaan yahan paanch cheezein hain jin ka bayaan aayat (Innallaha indahu ilmu-sa'ati wa yunazzilu-ghaitha wa ya'lamu ma fil-arhami, wa ma tadri nafsun maza taksibu ghadan, wa ma tadri nafsun bi-ayyi ardin tamutu, innallaha alimun khabir - 31:34) mein hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya paanch baatein hain jinhein Allah Ta'ala ke siva koi nahi jaanta, phir aap ne isi aayat ki tilawat farmayi. Bukhari ki hadith ke alfaaz toh yeh hain ke yeh paanch Ghaib ki kunjiyaan hain jinhein Allah ke siva koi nahi jaanta. Musnad Ahmad mein Huzoor ﷺ ka farmaan hai tujhe har cheez ki kunjiyaan di gayi hain siwaye paanch ke, phir yehi aayat aap ne parhi.

Hazrat Abu Hurairah ؓ farmate hain Huzoor hamari majlis mein baithe hue the ke ek sahib tashreef laye aur poochne lage iman kya cheez hai? Aap ne farmaya Allah ko, farishton ko, kitabon ko, rasoolon ko, akhirat ko, marne ke baad ji uthne ko maan lena. Us ne poocha Islam kya hai? Farmaya ek Allah ki ibaadat karna, us ke sath kisi ko shareek na karna, namazein parhna, zakat dena, Ramzan ke rozey rakhna. Us ne daryaft kiya ihsan kya hai? Farmaya tera is tarah Allah ki ibaadat karna ke goya tu usey dekh raha hai aur agar tu nahi dekhta toh woh tujhey dekh raha hai. Us ne kaha Huzoor Qiyamat kab hai? Farmaya is ka ilm na mujhe hai aur na tujhe hai, haan is ki kuch nishaniyan main tumhein bata deta hoon: jab londi apne miyan ko jane aur jab nange pairon aur nange badanon wale logon ke sardaar ban jayein. Ilm-e-Qiyamat un paanch cheezon mein se ek hai jinhein Allah ke siva koi nahi jaanta, phir aap ne isi aayat ki tilawat ki. Woh shakhs wapas chala gaya, aap ne farmaya jao isey lota lao, log daud pare lekin woh kahin bhi nazar na aaya. Aap ne farmaya ke yeh Jibrail thay, logon ko deen sikhane aaye thay (Bukhari). Hum ne is hadith ka matlab Sahih Bukhari mein khoob bayaan kiya hai.

Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Jibril ne apni hatheliyan Huzoor ﷺ ke ghutnon par rakh kar yeh sawalat kiye thay. Ek sahih sanad ke sath Musnad Ahmad mein marwi hai ke Bani Israel (Bani Amir) qabeele ka ek shakhs An-Hazrat ﷺ ke pas aya kehne laga main aoun? Apne khadim ko bheja ke ja kar unhe adab sikhaou yeh ijazat mangna nahi jante. Unse kaho pehle salam karo phir daryaft karo ke main asakta hun? Unhone sun liya aur usi tarah salam kiya aur ijazat chahi yeh gaye aur ja kar kaha ap hamare liye kya lekar aye hain? Apne farmaya bhalayi hi bhalayi. Suno tum ek Allah ki ibadat karo Lat-o-Uzza ko chhor do din raat mein panch namazein parha karo saal bhar mein ek mahine ke roze rakho apne maldaron se zakat wasool karke apne faqiron par taqseem karo. Unhone daryaft kiya Ya Rasoolallah ﷺ kya ilm mein se kuch aisa baqi hai jise ap na jante hon? Apne farmaya han aisa ilm bhi hai jise bajuz Allah Ta'ala ke koi nahi janta. Phir apne yehi ayat parhi. Mujahid farmate hain gaon ke rehne wale ek shakhs ne a kar Huzoor ﷺ se daryaft kiya tha ke meri aurat hamal se hai batlaye kya bacha hoga? Hamare shehar mein qaht hai farmaiye barish kab hogi? Yeh to main nahi janta ke main kab paida huwa lekin yeh ap maloom karadijiye ke kab marunga? Uske jawab mein yeh ayat utri ke mujhe in cheezon ka mutlaq ilm nahi. Mujahid farmate hain yehi ghaib ki kunjiyan hain jin ke bare mein farman-e-bari hai ke ghaib ki kunjiyan sirf Allah hi ke pas hain. Hazrat Siddiqa ؓ farmati hain jo tumse kahe ke Rasool Allah ﷺ kal ki baat ka ilm jante thay to samajh lena ke woh sabse bara jhoota hai. Allah Ta'ala farmate hain ke koi nahi janta ke kal kya hoga? Qatadah farmate hain ke bohat si cheezein aisi hain jin ka ilm Allah Ta'ala ne kisi ko nahi diya na Nabi ko na farishte ko Allah hi ke pas Qiyamat ka ilm hai koi nahi janta ke kis saal kis mahine kis din ya kis raat mein woh aye gi. Isi tarah barish ka ilm bhi uske siva kisi ko nahi ke kab aye? Aur koi nahi janta ke hamila ke pait mein bacha nar hoga ya mada surkh hoga ya siyah? Aur koi nahi janta ke kal woh neki karega ya badi karega? Marega ya jiye ga bohat mumkin hai kal mout ya afat ajaye. Na kisi ko yeh khabar hai ke kis zameen mein woh dabaya jayega ya samandar mein bahaya jayega ya jangal mein marega ya narm ya sakht zameen mein jayega. Hadith-e-Shareef mein hai jab kisi ko mout dusri zameen mein hoti hai toh uska wohin ka koi kaam nikal ata hai aur wohin mout ajati hai aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh farma kar Rasool-e-Kareem ﷺ ne yeh ayat parhi. A'sha Hamdan ke shair hain jin mein is mazmoon ko nihayat khubsurati se ada kiya hai. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Roz-e-Qiyamat zameen Allah Ta'ala se kahegi ke yeh hain teri amanatein jo tune mujhe sonp rakhi thin. Tabarani waghera mein bhi yeh hadith hai.
